papers.title: Greybody Factor in AdS Black Brane Spectroscopy: A Study with Scalar and Electromagnetic Perturbations
papers.abstract: We compute the greybody factor for scalar and photon radiations in AdS Schwarzschild black brane. We consider the linearized field equations satisfied by the minimally coupled massive scalar field and the transverse components of the Maxwell fields on the black brane background and recast them to the Heun's equations by appropriate change of variables and field redefinitions. At the asymptotic region, we consider appropriate linear combinations of the normalizable and non-normalizable solutions of the field equations to construct in/outgoing modes. We consider the ingoing solutions near horizon to construct the IN state and compute the coefficients of the in- and outgoing modes of the asymptotic solutions in terms of the connection coefficients of the Heun functions. Finally by calculating ratio of the coefficient of outgoing modes to the ingoing modes we find an exact expression for the greybody factor. We find that the greybody factor for the transverse Maxwell fields and that for the scalars dual to the conformal scalar primaries with integer scaling dimensions vanish off.

classification.title_zh: AdS黑洞膜光谱中的灰体因子：标量与电磁扰动研究
classification.abstract_zh: 我们计算了AdS Schwarzschild黑洞膜中标量和光子辐射的灰体因子。我们考虑了最小耦合有质量标量场和Maxwell场横向分量在黑洞膜背景上满足的线性化场方程，并通过适当的变量替换和场重定义将其改写为Heun方程。在渐近区域，我们取场方程的正规化与非正规化解的适当线性组合来构造入射/出射模式。我们考虑视界附近的入射解来构造IN态，并用Heun函数的连接系数计算渐近解的入、出射模式系数。最后，通过计算出射模式系数与入射模式系数之比，得到了灰体因子的精确表达式。我们发现横向Maxwell场的灰体因子与对偶于整数标度维度的共形标量原初标量场的灰体因子相互抵消。
classification.one_liner: 通过解析求解Heun方程，精确计算了AdS Schwarzschild黑洞膜上标量和电磁扰动的灰体因子，并发现两类场的贡献相互抵消。

papers.title: Higher-form (quasi)hydrodynamics from holography: deformations and dualities
papers.abstract: We study the low-energy dynamics of systems with exact and approximate higher-form symmetries using Gauge-gravity duality. These symmetries are realised holographically via generalised Maxwell/Proca theories for massless/massive $p$-forms in AlAdS spacetimes. Double-trace deformations of the boundary theory are considered via appropriate boundary conditions. We compute thermal correlation functions in isotropic black brane backgrounds to characterise the near equilibrium regimes of the dual boundary theories. In the vanishing-mass limit, the theory exhibits a hydrodynamic regime for weak double-trace deformations (relative to a scale set by the temperature) and a quasihydrodynamic regime for strong deformations. Turning on the bulk mass gives rise instead to a triad of quasihydrodynamic regimes controlled by both the mass and the double-trace coupling. In general, we find the low-energy spectra to be constrained by pole collisions, emergent symmetries and duality relations, the latter originating in part from Hodge-type dualities in the bulk. For nonzero mass, there is an additional strong/weak duality of the double-trace couplings. We further show, in the low-density limit of background charge, that relevant deformations are necessary for stable diffusion of sufficiently high-dimensional charged objects.

classification.title_zh: 来自全息的高阶形式（准）流体力学：变形与对偶
classification.abstract_zh: 我们利用规范-引力对偶研究了具有精确和近似高阶形式对称性的系统的低能动力学。这些对称性通过 AlAdS 时空中的无质量/有质量 p-形式推广 Maxwell/Proca 理论在全息上实现。通过适当的边界条件考虑边界理论的双迹变形。我们计算各向同性黑膜背景下的热关联函数，以刻画对偶边界理论的近平衡区域。在零质量极限下，对于弱双迹变形（相对于温度设定的标度），理论表现出流体力学区域；对于强变形，则出现准流体力学区域。打开体质量则导致由质量和双迹耦合共同控制的三重准流体力学区域。总的来说，我们发现低能谱受到极点碰撞、涌现对称性和对偶关系约束，后者部分源自体中的 Hodge 型对偶。对于非零质量，还存在双迹耦合的强/弱对偶。我们还表明，在背景电荷的低密度极限下，稳定高维带电物体的扩散需要相关变形。
classification.one_liner: 论文从 AdS/CFT 导出具有高阶形式对称性的系统的（准）流体动力学，系统分析双迹变形、质量与 Hodge 对偶对低能谱的影响。

papers.title: Running Love Numbers of Charged Black Holes
papers.abstract: Loops of virtual particles from the vacuum of quantum field theory (QFT) render black holes tidally deformable. We compute the static tidal response of unspinning charged black holes at arbitrary radius, using the perturbative formalism developed in 2501.18684. Since the gravitational and electromagnetic tidal responses mix, we generalize the notion of Love numbers to Love matrices. We derive the coupled equations of motion for the metric and electromagnetic fluctuations around purely electric and magnetic backgrounds. For large charged black holes, which are described by the Effective Field Theory (EFT) of gravity, we compute the full set of Love matrices induced by an arbitrary tower of $F^{2n}$ operators. We find that, although quantum corrections break electromagnetic duality, the Love matrices in electric and magnetic backgrounds are related by a $Z_2$ symmetry under electric-magnetic exchange. Going beyond EFT, we compute the Love matrices of small magnetic black holes. We show that the running of the Love matrices is governed by the running of the $U(1)$ gauge coupling, and we derive the correspondence between Love and $U(1)$ beta functions for arbitrary harmonics. The overall picture that emerges is that the QFT-induced tidal response of magnetic black holes saturates in the strong-field regime. These results imply that nearly-extremal magnetic black holes charged under an Abelian dark sector could be probed by gravitational-wave observations.

classification.title_zh: 带电黑洞的跑动Love数
classification.abstract_zh: 量子场论真空中的虚粒子圈使得黑洞具有潮汐形变。我们使用2501.18684中发展的微扰形式，计算任意半径下无自旋带电黑洞的静态潮汐响应。由于引力与电磁潮汐响应相互混合，我们将Love数的概念推广为Love矩阵。我们导出了纯电和纯磁背景周围度规与电磁涨落的耦合运动方程。对于由引力有效场论（EFT）描述的大带电黑洞，我们计算了由任意F^{2n}算符塔诱导的完整Love矩阵集合。我们发现，尽管量子修正破坏电磁对偶，但电背景与磁背景中的Love矩阵通过电-磁交换下的Z_2对称性关联。超越EFT，我们计算了小磁黑洞的Love矩阵。我们证明Love矩阵的跑动受U(1)规范耦合跑动支配，并推导了任意谐波下Love与U(1) beta函数之间的对应关系。总体图景是，QFT诱导的磁黑洞潮汐响应在强场区饱和。这些结果表明，在阿贝尔暗扇区下带电的近极端磁黑洞可通过引力波观测探及。
classification.one_liner: 计算带电黑洞的量子效应诱导Love矩阵，揭示其跑动与U(1) beta函数的对应，并预示近极端磁黑洞可被引力波探测。

papers.title: A fluid dual to the charged large D membrane paradigm
papers.abstract: According to the formulation of the charged large $D$ membrane paradigm, an arbitrary dynamic black hole solution to a theory of gravity with a $U(1)$ gauge field is dual to the dynamics of a membrane in a non-gravitational background. This membrane is endowed with a stress-energy tensor and a charge current, whose conservation equations govern its dynamics. In this work, we demonstrate that the dynamics of these membrane configurations (at the leading nontrivial order in $1/D$) can be mapped to a relativistic charged fluid, establishing a correspondence for asymptotically flat black holes with a particular class of fluid systems. Unlike the standard AdS/Hydrodynamics correspondence, this dual fluid does not reside on an asymptotic boundary, but is localised strictly on the non-gravitational membrane worldvolume. By evaluating the system in both the Eckart and Landau frames, we systematically extract the out-of-equilibrium transport coefficients. We find that the fluid is governed by a negative effective thermal conductivity and a negative heat capacity. This mechanism provides a hydrodynamic interpretation of thermodynamic stability, effectively translating the previously established quasinormal mode damping of the large-$D$ Reissner-Nordstr\"om geometry into the language of fluid dynamics.

classification.title_zh: 带电大D膜范式的流体对偶
classification.abstract_zh: 按照带电大D膜范式的表述，带有U(1)规范场的引力理论中的任意动态黑洞解对偶于非引力背景中膜的动力演化。该膜带有应力能量张量和电荷流，其守恒方程控制其动力学。本文证明，这些膜组态的动力演化（在1/D的最低非平凡阶）可以映射为相对论性带电流体，从而为渐近平坦黑洞与特定一类流体系统建立对应关系。与标准的AdS/流体动力学对应不同，该对偶流体并不位于渐近边界上，而是严格定域在非引力膜的世界体上。通过在Eckart和Landau参考系中评估该系统，我们系统提取了非平衡输运系数，发现流体受负等效热导率和负热容支配。该机制提供了对热力学稳定性的流体动力学解释，有效地将先前建立的大D Reissner-Nordström几何中的准正则模阻尼转化为流体动力学语言。
classification.one_liner: 将带电大D膜范式映射为相对论性带电流体，提取出具有负热导率/负热容的非平衡输运系数，并用流体语言解释RN黑洞QNM阻尼。

papers.title: Approximate higher-form symmetries and dualities of massive p-forms in the holographic bulk
papers.abstract: We develop a holographic framework for continuous higher-form symmetries and their low-energy effective descriptions, based on bulk path integrals, holographic renormalisation and boundary-condition-changing deformations. We show how approximate higher-form symmetries associated with a defect current can be realised holographically through massive antisymmetric tensor fields, either via parametrically small bulk masses or strong deformations associated with Robin boundary conditions. We further study the consequences of massless and massive Hodge dualities in the bulk, deriving the corresponding dualities between boundary theories related by different quantisation choices. Our results provide a unified perspective on approximate symmetries, dualities and strong/weak-coupling relations in holographic theories based on massive $p$-forms. In the self-dual case of an exact symmetry of degree $(d-3)/2$, we derive generalised constraints on holographic current-current correlators in the presence of double-trace deformations.

classification.title_zh: 全息体中的近似高阶对称性与有质量p-形式的对偶性
classification.abstract_zh: 我们基于体路径积分、全息重整化和边界条件改变形变，为连续高阶对称性及其低能有效描述发展了一个全息框架。我们展示了如何通过有质量反对称张量场，在体中以参数小体质量或与Robin边界条件相关的强形变，在全息上实现与缺陷电流相关的近似高阶对称性。我们进一步研究了体中无质量和有质量Hodge对偶性的后果，推导出由不同量子化选择相关的边界理论之间的相应二重性。我们的结果为基于有质量p-形式的全息理论中的近似对称性、二重性和强/弱耦合关系提供了一个统一视角。在精确(self-dual)对称度为(d-3)/2的情形下，我们推导了存在双trace形变时全息流-流关联函数的广义约束。
classification.one_liner: 发展了有质量p-形式全息描述高阶对称性的框架，推导了近似对称性与对偶性以及双trace形变下的约束。

papers.title: Topological changes and response singularities in black hole thermodynamic branch structure
papers.abstract: In this paper, we investigate how different diagnostics characterize the thermodynamic branch structure of black holes. In three charged AdS black hole examples, the thermodynamic topological transition point $\tau_a$, where the total topological number changes, is separated from the point $\tau_b$ where the branch response considered here, evaluated along a path with fixed charge parameters, becomes singular. Using the zero-point curves $\tau(r_h)$, we identify the local mechanisms behind this separation. At $\tau_a$, a zero point with nonzero winding enters or leaves the positive-radius physical branch set through the boundary of the counted domain, changing $W$ without making the corresponding positive-radius branch singular. At $\tau_b$, the zero-point curve develops a finite-radius turning point, where two branches with opposite winding numbers annihilate and the branch response diverges. Thus, in the analyzed examples, a change in the topological number records a change in branch membership, whereas a response singularity records a loss of local invertibility along an admitted branch. The two diagnostics therefore probe different local events of the same zero-point branch geometry.

classification.title_zh: 黑洞热力学分支结构中的拓扑变化与响应奇异性
classification.abstract_zh: 本文研究不同诊断量如何刻画黑洞热力学分支结构。在三个带电 AdS 黑洞例子中，热力学拓扑转变点 τ_a 与沿固定电荷参数路径求得的所考虑的分支响应发散点 τ_b 彼此分离。利用零点曲线 τ(r_h)，作者识别了这种分离背后的局域机制：在 τ_a 处，具有非零绕数的零点从被计数域边界进入或离开正半径物理分支集合，改变总拓扑数 W 而不使相应正半径分支奇异；在 τ_b 处，零点曲线在有限半径处形成转向点，两个绕数相反的分支湮灭，分支响应发散。因此，在所分析的例子中，拓扑数的改变记录分支隶属关系的变化，而响应奇异性记录沿许可分支的局域可逆性丢失。两个诊断量探测的是同一零点分支几何的不同局域事件。
classification.one_liner: 本文通过零点曲线解析黑洞热力学拓扑转变与响应发散的不同局域机制：前者对应分支归属改变，后者对应局域可逆性丧失。

papers.title: Complex CFTs: Holography and Interfaces
papers.abstract: We investigate complex conformal field theories and interfaces between such theories, using methods of holography and two dimensional CFT. We use holography to prove the Im-flip property of complex conjugate CFTs. We construct a complex Janus solution and calculate some holographic observables. Complex RG-flow interfaces are obtained numerically. On the CFT side, complex interfaces are constructed for free boson CFTs with and without background charge. Boundary states are constructed, and transmission and reflection coefficients are calculated in both cases.

classification.title_zh: 复数 CFT：全息与界面
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究了复数共形场论以及这类理论之间的界面，使用全息和二维 CFT 方法。我们利用全息证明了复共轭 CFT 的 Im-flip 性质。我们构造了一个复数 Janus 解，并计算了一些全息观测量。复数 RG 流界面通过数值方法得到。在 CFT 侧，我们为带和不带背景电荷的自由玻色子 CFT 构造了复数界面。在两种情况下都构造了边界态，并计算了透射和反射系数。

papers.title: Gravitational Baryogenesis in Energy-Momentum Squared~Gravity
papers.abstract: We demonstrate that the matter sector itself can drive baryogenesis in energy-momentum squared gravity, $f(R,\mathcal T^2)$ with $\mathcal T^2\equiv T_{\mu\nu}T^{\mu\nu}$. High-density matter corrections provide new time-dependent sources for the baryon asymmetry through derivative couplings to $\mathcal T^2$ and to the full combination $f(R,\mathcal T^2)$. Notably, the decoupling temperature is not treated as a free parameter; instead, it is fixed by the freeze-out of the Weinberg $B-L$-violating operator, directly linking the asymmetry to the light-neutrino mass scale and to the modified expansion history. Analyzing representative powers $n=1/4$, $n=1/2$, $n=5/8$, and $n=1$, we find that entropy evolution sharply distinguishes the models. The $n=1/4$ branch cannot serve as a self-contained radiation-era model, the $n=1/2$ branch is entropy-safe but too weak to reproduce the observed asymmetry, and the $n=1$ branch survives only after entropy dilution. Remarkably, the $n=5/8$ branch provides the cleanest viable realization, generating the observed baryon-to-entropy ratio with controlled effective-field-theory hierarchies.

classification.title_zh: 能量-动量平方引力中的引力重子产生
classification.abstract_zh: 我们证明物质扇区本身可以在能量-动量平方引力 $f(R,\mathcal T^2)$（其中 $\mathcal T^2\equiv T_{\mu\nu}T^{\mu\nu}$）中驱动重子产生。高密度物质修正通过与 $\mathcal T^2$ 以及完整组合 $f(R,\mathcal T^2)$ 的导数耦合，为重子不对称性提供了新的含时源。值得注意的是，退耦温度不视为自由参数；相反，它由 Weinberg $B-L$ 破坏算子的冻结过程固定，从而将不对称性与轻中微子质量标度和修正的膨胀历史直接联系起来。通过分析代表性幂次 $n=1/4$, $n=1/2$, $n=5/8$ 和 $n=1$，我们发现熵演化能清晰地区分这些模型。$n=1/4$ 分支不能作为自洽的辐射时期模型，$n=1/2$ 分支熵安全但过弱无法复现观测到的不对称性，$n=1$ 分支仅在熵稀释后存活。值得注意的是，$n=5/8$ 分支提供了最干净的可行实现，在受控的有效场论层级下产生观测到的重子-熵比。
classification.one_liner: 在能量-动量平方修改引力中，物质修正可在高密度下通过导数耦合产生重子不对称，其中 n=5/8 分支给出最干净的可行实现。

papers.title: Phenomenological Rotating Extension of Black Holes with Primary Scalar Hair: Shadow Signatures in Beyond Horndeski Gravity
papers.abstract: The Event Horizon Telescope (EHT) image of M87* provides a direct test of strong-field gravity, measuring an angular shadow diameter $\theta_{d}=42\pm 3~\mu\mathrm{as}$ and a circularity deviation $\Delta C\leq 0.1$. Such observations allow quantitative tests of the Kerr paradigm and of possible deviations from the no-hair theorem. In scalar-tensor extensions of gravity, black holes may possess primary scalar hair, introducing an additional independent parameter beyond mass and spin. In this work, we construct a rotating configuration inspired by black hole solutions with primary scalar hair in beyond Horndeski gravity and analyze their photon regions and shadow formation. We show that the scalar hair parameter $Q$ induces characteristic modifications of the shadow, and in particular negative $Q$ enlarges the shadow and reduces its oblateness, while positive $Q$ shrinks and enhances its distortion. Adopting M87* as a representative case within this framework and imposing the EHT bounds on $\theta_{d}$ and $\Delta C$, we identify the viable $(a,Q)$ parameter space. We find that current observations do not exclude rotating black holes with primary scalar hair, although the allowed region is significantly restricted for $Q>0$. Finally, the scalar-hair-induced deviations are of order $\mathcal{O}(\mu\mathrm{as})$, placing them near the sensitivity threshold of present instruments and within reach of next-generation horizon-scale imaging.

classification.title_zh: 带主标量毛发的旋转黑洞的现象学扩展：超越 Horndeski 引力中的阴影特征
classification.abstract_zh: 事件视界望远镜（EHT）对M87*的成像提供了强场引力的直接检验，测得其角阴影直径θd=42±3 μas，圆度偏差ΔC≤0.1。这类观测允许对Kerr范式以及对无毛定理可能偏离的情形进行定量检验。在引力的标量-张量扩展中，黑洞可能拥有主标量毛发，从而引入质量与自旋之外的额外独立参数。本文基于超越Horndeski引力中带主标量毛发的黑洞解，构造了一个转动构型，并分析了其光子区和阴影形成。我们发现，标量毛发参数Q会引起阴影的特征性修改：负Q使阴影增大并降低扁率，正Q则减小阴影并增强变形。以M87*作为代表性案例并施加EHT对θd和ΔC的约束，我们确定了可行的(a,Q)参数空间。我们发现，当前观测并不排除带主标量毛发的转动黑洞，尽管Q>0时允许区域受到显著限制。最后，标量毛发诱发的偏离约为微角秒量级，接近当前仪器的灵敏度极限，并处于下一代视界尺度成像的可及范围。
classification.one_liner: 用M87*的EHT观测约束带主标量毛发的旋转黑洞，发现负（正）毛发参数会增大（减小）阴影并改变形状，现有观测仍允许这类黑洞。

papers.title: Anti-Ultralocality and Plateau Models of Inflation
papers.abstract: Anti-ultralocality refers to the growth of spatial gradient terms relative to velocity terms in the coupled Einstein--scalar field equations. It is a characteristic feature of decelerated expansion before the onset of inflation. Previous numerical relativity studies have shown that anti-ultralocality prevents the onset of inflation in models with power-law inflaton potentials. In this paper, we show that models with plateau-shaped inflaton potentials, which are considered to be the simplest way to generate a tensor-to-scalar ratio below current observational upper limits, are especially vulnerable to anti-ultralocality effects. The reasons are the flatness of the plateau and the energy density gap of $\sim 10$ orders of magnitude between the Planck density and the plateau potential energy. To study the problem, we develop a protocol for assessing the viability of inflationary models in general, and we apply it to a plateau potential using a previously validated numerical relativity code. We find that, starting from generic initial conditions, the growth of gradient terms in the Einstein equations relative to non-gradient terms either prevents inflation from lasting for enough $e$-folds or triggers a phase of quantum runaway. We show that the fine-tuning of initial conditions necessary to avoid these issues becomes more severe as the energy scale of inflation is made smaller, disfavoring common approaches for reducing the tensor-to-scalar ratio.

classification.title_zh: 反超局域性与暴涨的高原势模型
classification.abstract_zh: 反超局域性指的是在耦合的爱因斯坦-标量场方程中，空间梯度项相对于速度项的增长。它是暴涨开始之前减速膨胀的一个特征。先前的数值相对论研究表明，在具有幂律暴胀势的模型中，反超局域性会阻止暴涨的开始。在本文中，我们表明，具有高原形暴胀势的模型——这被认为是产生低于当前观测上限的张标比的最简单方法——尤其容易受到反超局域性效应的影响。其原因在于高原的平直性以及普朗克密度与高原势能之间约10个数量级的能量密度差距。为研究此问题，我们开发了一个评估一般暴胀模型可行性的协议，并将其应用于高原势，使用先前已验证的数值相对论代码。我们发现，从一般初始条件出发，爱因斯坦方程中梯度项相对于非梯度项的增长要么使暴涨无法持续足够的e-折数，要么触发量子失控阶段。我们还表明，为避免这些问题所需的初始条件精细调节随着暴涨能标的降低而变得更加严重，这不利于降低张标比的常见方法。
classification.one_liner: 高原势暴胀模型因势的平坦性和巨大能量差，对反超局域性特别敏感，更容易导致e-折不足或量子失控，且低能标需要更精细的初始条件。

papers.title: Effects of Strong Magnetic Fields on the Equation of State and Mass-Radius Structure of Hyperonic Neutron-Star Matter with Anomalous Magnetic Moments
papers.abstract: We investigate the effects of strong magnetic fields on the equation of state (EoS) and stellar structure of cold, charge-neutral, $\beta$-equilibrated hyperonic neutron-star matter within a relativistic mean-field (RMF) framework. The matter sector contains the full baryon octet and leptons, while charged particles are Landau quantized and all baryons are coupled to the magnetic field through their anomalous magnetic moments (AMM). The calculation is performed with the RMF FSU2H hyperonic parameterization and compared for zero field, constant magnetic fields, and density-dependent magnetic-field profiles. We find that strong magnetic fields modify the hyperonic composition through the competing effects of Landau quantization and AMM-induced spin splitting. Landau quantization softens the magnetized hyperonic equation of state. The inclusion of AMM provides an additional magnetic stiffening mechanism in hyperonic matter. The results for the inclusion of the AMM coupling and not are still consistent with observations of $2.00$-$2.02\,M_{\odot}$ neutron stars and small radii. The present work therefore provides a benchmark for assessing the influence of AMM on the composition, magnetization, equation of state, and mass-radius structure of magnetized hyperonic neutron-star matter.

classification.title_zh: 强磁场及反常磁矩对超子中子星物质状态方程和质量-半径结构的影响
classification.abstract_zh: 我们在相对论平均场（RMF）框架下研究强磁场对冷、电荷中性、β平衡的超子中子星物质的状态方程（EoS）和恒星结构的影响。物质部分包含完整重子八重态和轻子，带电粒子被朗道量子化，所有重子通过其反常磁矩（AMM）与磁场耦合。计算采用RMF FSU2H超子参数化，并对零场、恒定磁场和密度相关磁场轮廓进行了比较。我们发现强磁场通过朗道量子化和AMM诱导的自旋劈裂的竞争效应改变超子组成。朗道量子化使磁化超子状态方程变软。AMM的加入为超子物质提供了额外的磁硬化机制。有无AMM耦合的结果都与2.00-2.02太阳质量中子星和小半径的观测相容。因此，当前工作为评估AMM对磁化超子中子星物质的组成、磁化、状态方程和质量-半径结构的影响提供了一个基准。

papers.title: Spin alignment of vector mesons in a plasma at finite density
papers.abstract: We study the spectral functions and spin alignment of $J/\psi$ and $\phi$ mesons at finite density within a soft wall holographic model that provides the quark-gluon plasma background, with vector mesons represented by bulk vector fields. We derive the relation between the production rates in distinct spin channels and the corresponding in-medium spectral functions, and examine their dependence on the chemical potential, meson momentum, and temperature. We analyze the spin alignment induced by the motion of the vector meson relative to the thermal bath. At $T=0.15~\mathrm{GeV}$, the $J/\psi$ spectral function exhibits a clear resonance peak, indicating that the $c\bar{c}$ pair can still form a quasistable bound state. As the chemical potential increases, this peak becomes lower and broader, signaling enhanced dissociation in the medium. For the $\phi$ meson at the same temperature, no pronounced peak is observed, indicating substantial melting; its spectral function thus better characterizes the distribution of unstable $s\bar{s}$ pairs in the thermal environment. At $T=0.15~\mathrm{GeV}$, the helicity-frame spin alignment parameter $\rho_{00}$ shows a positive deviation from $1/3$ for the $J/\psi$ and a negative one for the $\phi$ meson. A finite chemical potential alters these deviations, reducing the magnitude for the $J/\psi$ while increasing it for the $\phi$ meson.

classification.title_zh: 有限密度等离子体中矢量介子的自旋排列
classification.abstract_zh: 我们在软墙全息模型中研究了有限密度下 J/psi 和 phi 介子的谱函数与自旋排列。该模型提供了夸克-胶子等离子体背景，其中矢量介子由体矢量场表示。我们推导了不同自旋道产生率与介质中对应谱函数之间的关系，并考察了它们对化学势、介子动量和温度的依赖。我们分析了矢量介子相对于热浴运动所诱导的自旋排列。在 T = 0.15 GeV 时，J/psi 谱函数呈现清晰共振峰，表明 c-cbar 对仍可形成准稳定束缚态；随着化学势增大，该峰变低、变宽，标志着介质中解离增强。对于相同温度下的 phi 介子，没有观察到显著峰，表明其发生显著熔化；因此其谱函数更适合描述热环境中不稳定 s-sbar 对的分布。在 T = 0.15 GeV，螺旋度框架下的自旋排列参数 rho_00 对 J/psi 呈现相对于 1/3 的正偏差，对 phi 呈现负偏差。有限化学势会改变上述偏差：对 J/psi 减小其大小，对 phi 增大其大小。

papers.title: Holographic light-quark energy loss in a spinning plasma
papers.abstract: In this work, we investigate light-quark energy loss in a strongly coupled plasma described by a spinning black-brane background obtained from the large-black-hole limit of the Myers--Perry geometry. The parameter $a$ characterizes the boost/rotation of the dual fluid in this holographic setup and is related to the angular velocity in the corresponding limit. We employ two complementary probes, the falling-string and shooting-string descriptions, to compute the stopping distance and the instantaneous energy loss of a light quark moving either transverse or parallel to the rotation axis. The results show that light quarks thermalize more readily in a hot environment. For parallel propagation, a counter-propagating configuration facilitates thermalization, whereas a co-propagating configuration suppresses it. For transverse propagation, increasing the magnitude of the rotational motion promotes thermalization. In addition, the instantaneous energy loss increases along the trajectory of the endpoint.

classification.title_zh: 旋转等离子体中的全息轻夸克能量损失
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究了由大黑洞极限下的Myers-Perry几何得到的旋转黑膜背景所描述的强耦合等离子体中的轻夸克能量损失。参数a表征该全息设置中双流体的推进/旋转，并与相应极限中的角速度相关。我们采用两种互补探针——下落弦和射击弦描述——来计算分别平行于旋转轴和垂直于旋转轴运动的轻夸克的停止距离与瞬时能量损失。结果表明，轻夸克在热环境中更容易热化。对于平行传播，逆流构型促进热化，而同向传播构型抑制热化。对于横向传播，增大旋转运动的幅度会促进热化。此外，瞬时能量损失沿着终点的轨迹增加。

papers.title: Quantum Complexity Dynamics for Disjoint Subsystems
papers.abstract: Quantum complexity has emerged as a natural probe of chaos, thermalization, and the black hole interior on timescales long after local observables have equilibrated. However, its time evolution has been studied almost exclusively in subsystems confined to a single connected region. We show, using complementary tools from holography and random quantum circuits, that noncontiguous subsystems composed of multiple disjoint regions give rise to qualitatively new physics compared to the contiguous case. First, at finite temperature, a subsystem occupying less than half of the total system can carry high complexity at late times, even as the complexity of its larger complement remains low. This inversion of the usual hierarchy is intrinsically thermal: it vanishes in the infinite-temperature limit, which is the regime modeled by random quantum circuits. Second, if a subsystem's complexity equilibrates at an early time, then fragmenting it into $m$ disjoint components can further reduce this timescale by a factor of $m$, a phenomenon we exhibit in both holography and random quantum circuits. These results not only sharpen the correspondence between geometric and computational notions of complexity, but also motivate the search for novel complexity phenomena in quantum dynamics.

classification.title_zh: 不相交子系统的量子复杂性动力学
classification.abstract_zh: 量子复杂性已成为在局域可观测量达到平衡很久之后，探测混沌、热化以及黑洞内部的时间尺度上的自然探针。然而，其时间演化几乎仅在局限于单一连通区域的子系统中被研究。我们利用全息方法和随机量子电路的互补工具表明，由多个不相交区域组成的非连通子系统相比连通情形会引发定性的新物理。首先，在有限温度下，占据总系统不到一半的子系统在晚期可以携带高复杂性，即使其更大的补集的复杂性仍然较低。这种通常层级关系的反转本质上是热效应：它在无限温度极限下消失，而该极限正是随机量子电路所模拟的机制。其次，如果子系统的复杂性在早期达到平衡，那么将其分割为m个不相交分量可进一步将该时间尺度缩小因子m，这一现象在全息和随机量子电路中都有体现。这些结果不仅深化了复杂性之几何与计算概念间的对应，也激励人们在量子动力学中寻找新的复杂性现象。
classification.one_liner: 利用全息与随机量子电路，揭示不相交子系统的复杂性动力学出现新的热化与层级反转现象。

papers.title: A 1/4-BPS chiral algebra in D1D5: from charge concentration to BPS chaos
papers.abstract: The D1D5 CFT exhibits a charge concentration puzzle for BPS states, similar to, but simpler than, that of $\mathcal{N}=4$ SYM. We consider the chiral algebra of 1/4-BPS operators in the D1D5 CFT arising from a supercharge cohomology, and the resulting rational correlators. Using crossing symmetry and this chiral algebra, we establish a non-perturbative proof of the existence of a family of 1/4-BPS states away from the charge concentration locus for general coupling and finite central charge. We further discuss possible implications for BPS chaos in the D1D5 CFT and compute a late-time BPS plateau at the orbifold point.

classification.title_zh: D1D5 中一个 1/4-BPS 手征代数：从电荷集中到 BPS 混沌
classification.abstract_zh: D1D5 CFT 在 BPS 态上表现出电荷集中疑难，该疑难类似于（但比 N=4 SYM 更简单）。我们考虑了 D1D5 CFT 中由超荷上同调产生的 1/4-BPS 算符的手征代数，以及由此得到的有理关联函数。利用交叉对称性和该手征代数，我们对于一般耦合和有限中心荷，非微扰地证明了在电荷集中点之外存在一族 1/4-BPS 态。我们进一步讨论了其对 D1D5 CFT 中 BPS 混沌的可能影响，并在 orbifold 点上计算了晚期 BPS 平台。

papers.title: On the mass spectrum of Viel-dreibein gravity
papers.abstract: We study the AdS-wave configurations of Viel-dreibein gravity, a three-dimensional theory of $N$ interacting spin-2 fields, as a pretext to characterize the mass spectrum of this multigravity theory. We manage to implement the known strategy of rewriting the system as a higher-derivative theory for a single dreibein, thereby deriving the precise $2N$th-order equation governing the dynamics of the AdS-wave profile in question. The second novelty we introduce is a factorization of such an equation as the product of $N$ Klein-Gordon operators, exploiting the recent representation of the roots of any $N$th-degree polynomial in terms of the increasingly celebrated $\mathscr{A}$-hypergeometric functions. Remarkably, this allows us to determine the mass spectrum of the full theory independently of the number of involved gravities, which is essential for an explicit construction of the AdS-wave solutions. This enables us to explore the parameter space of the theory and find all its critical points (not only the Breitenlohner-Freedman bounds) where a much wider range of degeneracies in the squared masses arises. At those points, the solutions allow a zoo of new logarithmic modes leading to several $\log^{\chi-1}$ asymptotic behaviors, with $\chi\le N$, a signature of the existence of allegedly dual logarithmic conformal field theories.

classification.title_zh: Viel-dreibein 引力的质谱
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究Viel-dreibein引力的AdS波构型——这是一个由N个相互作用的自旋2场组成的三维理论——以此作为刻画这一多重量力理论质量谱的切入点。我们成功实现了将该系统重新写为单一dreibein的高阶导数理论的已知策略，从而导出了所讨论AdS波剖面所遵循的精确2N阶运动方程。我们引入的第二个新意是：利用最近关于任何N次多项式的根可以用日益著名的$\mathscr{A}$-超几何函数表示的结果，将该方程因式分解为N个Klein-Gordon算子的乘积。值得注意的是，这让我们能够独立于所涉及引力子数来确定整个理论的质量谱，这对于显式构造AdS波解至关重要。这使得我们得以探索该理论的参数空间，并找到其所有临界点（不仅仅是Breitenlohner-Freedman界），在这些点上质量二次方会出现远更广泛的简并性。在这些点，解允许大量新的对数模式，导致多种$\log^{\chi-1}$渐近行为（$\chi\le N$），这标志了推测存在对偶的对数共形场论。
classification.one_liner: 通过AdS波分析，将Viel-dreibein多重量力系统化为高阶导数方程并因式分解为N个Klein-Gordon算子，从而解析确定质量谱，并在临界点发现类似log CFT的对数新模式。

papers.title: Iso-$\mu/T$ holographic entropy and its attractor for a strongly coupled quantum fluid
papers.abstract: Numerical evidence has shown that a period of vanishing entropy production during far-from-equilibrium stages induces subsequent violations of the dominant energy condition in strongly coupled plasmas. This behavior also appears to hold for a Bjorken-expanding, hot and dense strongly coupled quantum fluid. In this context, it has been established that the chemical potential-to-temperature ratio ($\mu/T$) in the medium increases with higher initial charge density, $\rho_0$, and/or lower initial energy density, $\varepsilon_0$. Here, we present a numerical method to evolve Bjorken R-charged plasmas by varying $(\varepsilon_0,\rho_0)$ in order to generate a curve that preserves a constant $\mu/T$. This allows us to address the case in which all Bekenstein-Hawking entropy densities evolve towards configurations with the same $\mu/T$. This approach enables a more direct comparison with the $\mathcal{N}=4$ SYM plasma case ($\mu/T=0$) and, consequently, provides clearer evidence of the correlation between entropy production and violations of the dominant energy condition. Moreover, this procedure offers a characterization (albeit numerical and partial) of the iso$-\mu/T$ entropy density hydrodynamic attractor for hot and dense strongly coupled quantum fluids.

classification.title_zh: 等$\mu/T$全息熵及其对强耦合量子流体的吸引子
classification.abstract_zh: 数值证据表明，在远离平衡阶段，一段消失的熵产生时期会诱发强耦合等离子体中主导能量条件的后续违反。这种行为似乎也适用于Bjorken膨胀的热而密的强耦合量子流体。在此背景下，已经确定介质中化学势-温度比($\mu/T$)随着初始电荷密度$\rho_0$的增大和/或初始能量密度$\varepsilon_0$的减小而增加。这里，我们提出一种数值方法，通过变化$(\varepsilon_0,\rho_0)$来演化Bjorken R电荷等离子体，从而生成保持恒定$\mu/T$的曲线。这使我们能够讨论所有Bekenstein-Hawking熵密度演化到具有相同$\mu/T$的构型的情况。这种方法能够与$\mathcal{N}=4$ SYM等离子体情况($\mu/T=0$)进行更直接的比较，从而为熵产生与主导能量条件违反之间的关联提供更清晰的证据。此外，这一过程为热而密的强耦合量子流体提供了iso$-\mu/T$熵密度流体动力学吸引子的表征（尽管是数值且局部的）。

papers.title: Fuchsian Resonance and a Horizon-to-Boundary Dictionary for Pole-Skipping
papers.abstract: Pole-skipping occurs at special complex frequencies and momenta where the retarded Green function of a black-hole or black-brane background is not uniquely defined. The local near-horizon mechanism is well known: at resonance, a Frobenius recurrence matrix loses rank and the space of smooth horizon solutions enlarges. We address the global question of how two boundary-normalized solutions enter this resonant horizon solution space. For a general second-order scalar radial equation on a nonextremal background analytic near the horizon, the Frobenius recurrence at the resonant order yields a solvability condition. We prove that its vanishing is equivalent to singularity of the horizon recurrence matrix, absence of the logarithmic Frobenius term, and existence of two independent smooth horizon solutions. Away from resonance, the source zero is equivalent to horizon smoothness of the response-normalized solution, while the response zero is equivalent to horizon smoothness of the source-normalized solution. We then analyze the parameter-dependent simple pole of the nonresonant ingoing solution as resonance is approached. After removing this singularity, its resonant limit is proportional to the larger-root Frobenius solution, with proportionality factor given by the same solvability function. Continuing to the boundary shows that the same condition is equivalent to simultaneous vanishing of the two regularized boundary connection coefficients. This establishes a horizon-to-boundary dictionary between local Fuchsian resonance and the boundary source-response 0/0 structure of pole-skipping. Finally, different directions of approach can select different resonant solutions, with the selection governed by the first parameter variation of the same solvability function.

classification.title_zh: Fuchsian共振与极点跳跃的视界到边界词典
classification.abstract_zh: 极点跳跃发生在黑洞或黑膜背景的延迟格林函数在特殊复频率和动量处未被唯一定义的情况。局域近视界机制是已知的：在共振处，Frobenius递推矩阵失去秩，使得光滑视界解空间扩大。我们处理两个边界归一化解是如何进入这一共振视界解空间的全局问题。对一般非极端背景上的一般二阶标量径向方程，在共振阶处的Frobenius递推产生一个可解性条件。我们证明该条件的消失等价于视界递推矩阵的奇异性、对数Frobenius项的缺失以及两个独立光滑视界解的存在性。远离共振，源零点等价于响应归一化解的视界光滑性，而响应零点等价于源归一化解的视界光滑性。我们进一步分析依赖参数的共振逼近过程中非共振内行解的简单极点。移除该奇点后，其共振极限正比于大根Frobenius解，比例因子正是同一可解性函数。继续延拓到边界表明，同一条件等价于两个正则化边界连接系数的同时消失。这建立起局域Fuchsian共振与极点跳跃的边界源-响应0/0结构之间的视界到边界词典。最后，不同的趋近方向可以选择不同的共振解，这种选择由同一可解性函数的一阶参数变分所控制。
classification.one_liner: 严格证明极点跳跃的Fuchsian共振条件等价于边界连接系数的整体消失，建立了从视界Frobenius结构到边界Green函数零点/极点的完整词典。

papers.title: Perturbative Double-Scalar Hair on Planar Black Holes in AdS$_{4}$ Einstein-Scalar Gravity
papers.abstract: We construct a two-scalar hairy planar black hole in four-dimensional Einstein gravity coupled to two scalars whose potential descends from the ABJM consistent truncation of eleven-dimensional supergravity. Starting from the known single-scalar hairy black brane, we switch on the second scalar $\phim$ perturbatively in its amplitude $\eps$ and solve the coupled Einstein-scalar system to order $\eps^{2}$. The linearized $\phim$ profile is an exact hypergeometric function, independent of the $\pp$ hair, whose horizon-regular branch always carries a source, so there is no spontaneous $\phim$ hair. Because the dual operator $\mathcal{O}_{-}$ is irrelevant ($\Delta=4$), the second-order response develops a logarithmically running condensate with a closed-form, scheme-independent slope $\tfrac{\sqrt{21}}{70}C_{s}^{2}$. The renormalized free energy is scheme dependent, but the geometric temperature shift $\delta T/T_{0}\approx-0.345\,\eps^{2}$ at fixed entropy is not. The full metric and $\pp$ back-reaction is obtained in closed form, diagonalizing into two P\"oschl-Teller problems with $\delta\pp=\tfrac{6}{\sqrt7}\,\delta H$. Three transport coefficients of the dual fluid remain exactly conformal to this order, while the sound speed, like the free energy, is scheme dependent.

classification.title_zh: AdS4 Einstein-Scalar 引力中平面黑洞上的微扰双标量毛发
classification.abstract_zh: 我们在四维 Einstein 引力耦合两个标量的系统中构造了双标量毛发的平面黑洞，其势函数源自 ABJM 一致性截断的 11 维超引力。从已知的单标量毛发黑洞膜出发，我们以振幅 ε 微扰地开启第二个标量 φ_m，并将耦合的 Einstein-标量系统解到 ε² 阶。线性化的 φ_m 轮廓是精确的超几何函数，与 π 毛发无关；其视界正则支总是附带源，因此不存在自发的 φ_m 毛发。由于对偶算符 O_- 是无关的 (Δ=4)，二阶响应会发展出对数跑动凝聚，其闭式、与方案无关的斜率为 √21/70 C_s²。重整化自由能是方案依赖的，但在固定熵下几何温度移动 δT/T₀ ≈ -0.345 ε² 不是。完整的度规和 π 反作用是闭式得到的，可对角化成两个 Pöschl-Teller 问题，且有 δπ = 6/√7 δH。对偶流体的三个输运系数在该阶仍精确共形，而声速与自由能一样是方案依赖的。
classification.one_liner: 在 ABJM 截断启发的 AdS4 Einstein-scalar 理论中，从单标量毛平面黑洞微扰开启第二个标量；线性支恒带源故无自发毛发，二阶效应给出对数跑动凝聚，同时揭示了自由能与声速的方案依赖性和温度移动的方案无关性。
classification.relevance_reason: 该工作基于 ABJM 截断构造 AdS4 平面黑洞的双标量微扰解，核心属于 AdS/CFT 字典与经典黑洞引力方向；与用户列出的全息超流、p 波、探针膜、相变与气泡等具体主线没有直接交叉，故列为中等相关。

papers.title: Positive energy from timelike singularities
papers.abstract: The energy of various asymptotically AdS and asymptotically flat solutions to the Einstein equations with time-translational invariance and a timelike singularity is computed, spaces with Kasner timelike singularities and black holes with negative masses among them. The definition used for gravitational energy is the on-shell Hamiltonian of the physical classical action proposed by Hawking and Horowitz thirty years ago and which agrees with the Abbott-Deser and ADM expressions. To deal with the singularity, a timelike regulating cut-off boundary surrounding the singularity compatible with a well-defined foliation in constant-time slices is introduced, so calculations are performed at a finite value of the regulating parameter, which is set to zero in the final expression for the energy. In all instances considered, the energy contribution from the singularity is finite and positive, its value depends on the geometry around the singularity and is such that the total gravitational energy is positive. Of the solutions reviewed, only the AdS soliton (which has no singularity) has negative gravitational energy relative to AdS space. The AdS and the Schwarzschild black holes with negative masses have respectively the same energies as AdS and Minkowski spaces.

classification.title_zh: 来自类时奇点的正能量
classification.abstract_zh: 计算了具有时间平移不变性和类时奇点的若干渐近AdS与渐近平直Einstein解的引力能量，其中包括具有Kasner类时奇点的时空和负质量黑洞。所使用的引力能量定义是Hawking与Horowitz三十年前提出的物理经典作用量的壳上Hamiltonian，它与Abbott-Deser及ADM表达式一致。为处理奇点，引入一个围绕奇点并与良定义等时切片叶状结构相容的类时正则化截断边界，计算在有限的截断参数值上进行，最终的能量表达式再令其趋于零。在所有考察的例子中，奇点对能量的贡献都有限且为正；其数值取决于奇点附近的几何，并使总引力能量为正。在回顾的解中，只有无奇点的AdS孤子具有相对于AdS空间的负引力能量。带负质量的AdS与Schwarzschild黑洞则分别与AdS空间和Minkowski空间具有相同的能量。
classification.one_liner: 采用Hawking-Horowitz壳上Hamiltonian计算含类时奇点的渐近AdS/平直时空的引力能量，发现奇点能量贡献有限且为正，负质量黑洞与相应真空同能量。

papers.title: Perturbations and stability of black holes with static scalar hair in general GLPV theories
papers.abstract: We derive the background equations and complete odd- and even-parity quadratic actions for static, spherically symmetric black holes with radial scalar hair in general quartic-quintic Gleyzes-Langlois-Piazza-Vernizzi (GLPV) theories, including Horndeski. On regular, nondegenerate branches, the formulation applies across Killing horizons and yields local no-ghost conditions and radial and angular eikonal characteristics. Tensor modes in both parity sectors share the same squared radial speed. When the radial coordinate is timelike, generic antisymmetric mixing induces nonstandard large-multipole scaling for both even-parity angular branches. Requiring both branches to have finite, nonzero eikonal phase speeds selects the Horndeski-related compatibility condition between the quartic and quintic beyond-Horndeski functions. This condition aligns the covariant degeneracy directions and permits a local disformal map to Horndeski when regular and invertible. For a finite, nonzero scalar kinetic term at the horizon, every nontrivial branch of the exact quadratic GLPV black hole is locally unstable or has a degenerate tensor cone near a simple outer horizon. Apart from identified exceptions, this obstruction extends to general shift- and reflection-symmetric quadratic GLPV theories and the regular Horndeski-related branch of the quartic-quintic class. Finally, for scalar-Gauss-Bonnet black holes with a vanishing horizon scalar kinetic term, we construct analytic power-law quartic beyond-Horndeski deformations whose associated quintic function is fixed by the same condition. At sufficiently small coupling, all local no-ghost and high-frequency gradient-stability conditions hold throughout the exterior. For a linear Gauss-Bonnet coupling, we estimate an interior scale below which the background and stability expansions lose perturbative control; this does not imply a physical instability.

classification.title_zh: 一般GLPV理论中具有静态标量毛的黑洞的微扰与稳定性
classification.abstract_zh: 我们在一般的quartic-quintic GLPV理论（包括Horndeski）中推导了具有径向标量毛的静态球对称黑洞的背景方程和完整的奇、偶宇称二次作用量。在规则的、非退化分支上，该形式适用于越过Killing视界，并给出局部无鬼条件以及径向和角向eikonal特征。两个宇称部分的张量模式具有相同的平方径向速度。当径向坐标为类时，一般的反对称混合会导致偶宇称角向分支出现非标准的大多极标度。要求两个分支具有有限非零的eikonal相位速度，会选择quartic和quintic beyond-Horndeski函数之间的Horndeski相关兼容条件。该条件使协变退化方向对齐，并在规则且可逆时允许局部的disformal映射到Horndeski理论。对于视界处非零且有限的标量动能项，精确二次GLPV黑洞的每个非平凡分支在简单外视界附近局部不稳定或具有退化张量锥。除了已识别的例外，这一阻碍扩展到一般的移位和反射对称二次GLPV理论以及quartic-quintic类的正则Horndeski相关分支。最后，对于视界标量动能消失的标量-高斯-博内黑洞，我们构造了解析幂律quartic beyond-Horndeski形变，其关联的quintic函数由同一条件固定。在足够小的耦合下，所有局部无鬼和高频梯度稳定性条件在外域都成立。对于线性高斯-博内耦合，我们估计了一个内部尺度，低于该尺度背景和稳定性展开将失去微扰控制；这并不意味着物理不稳定性。
classification.one_liner: 推导GLPV理论中静态标量毛黑洞的二次摄动作用量，证明其局部不稳定性/退化张量锥，并在标量-高斯-博内情形构建稳定形变。

papers.title: Reissner-Nordstrom in the Bertotti-Robinson-Bonnor-Melvin electromagnetic field
papers.abstract: The magnetic Reissner-Nordstrom black hole embedded into the Bertotti-Robinson magnetic field is presented. Then it is used, as a seed, to generate, through the Harrison transformation of the Ersnt's equations, the Reissner-Nordstrom metric in the Bertotti-Robinson-Bonnor-Melvin magnetic field. Special cases generalising, the vacuum hairy type I Schwarzschild solution is discussed. The local equivalence between various forms of the Schwarzschild-Bertotti-Robinson is shown by exhibiting the explicit diffeomorphism.

classification.title_zh: 在Bertotti-Robinson-Bonnor-Melvin电磁场中的Reissner-Nordstrom黑洞
classification.abstract_zh: 将磁Reissner-Nordstrom黑洞嵌入Bertotti-Robinson磁场中。然后以此为种子，通过Ernst方程的Harrison变换，生成在Bertotti-Robinson-Bonnor-Melvin磁场中的Reissner-Nordstrom度规。讨论了真空带毛I型Schwarzschild解的推广特例。通过显式微分同胚展示了Schwarzschild-Bertotti-Robinson各种形式之间的局部等价性。
classification.one_liner: 构造嵌入BRBM电磁场的RN黑洞解，并展示相关度规等价性。

papers.title: Charging higher-dimensional spacetimes with a generalized Kerr-Schild transformation
papers.abstract: We explore the construction of higher-dimensional Einstein-Maxwell(-Chern-Simons) solutions from vacuum seeds by means of a generalized Kerr-Schild transformation along a geodesic null vector field $\mathbf{k}$. Assuming the vector potential $\mathbf{A}$ to be aligned with $\mathbf{k}$, and $\mathbf{k}$ to be a Weyl aligned null direction satisfying the ``optical constraint'', we arrive at three distinct branches of solutions. If $\mathbf{k}$ is expanding and twisting, then its shear must vanish -- this branch includes certain charged Taub-NUT metrics. If $\mathbf{k}$ is expanding and twistfree, one finds two subfamilies: Robinson-Trautman electrovac solutions with a non-null Maxwell field if the shear is zero, or shearing solutions with a null field. Finally, the case when $\mathbf{k}$ is non-expanding reduces to a subset of the known Kundt solutions. In all cases, the Chern-Simons term turns out to be identically zero on-shell. In passing, by relaxing the alignment assumption on $\mathbf{A}$, we also obtain a six-dimensional extension of a charged Taub-NUT metric for which the magnetic part of the field strength is a linear combination of two distinct K\"ahler 2-forms, as opposed to the previously known examples in more than four dimensions.

classification.title_zh: 用广义 Kerr-Schild 变换为高维时空充电
classification.abstract_zh: 我们探讨了如何通过沿测地类光矢量场 k 的广义 Kerr-Schild 变换，从真空种子构建高维 Einstein-Maxwell(-Chern-Simons) 解。假设矢量势 A 与 k 对齐，且 k 是满足“光学约束”的 Weyl 对齐类光方向，我们得到三个不同的解分支。若 k 是膨胀且扭曲的，则其剪切必须为零——该分支包括某些带荷 Taub-NUT 度量。若 k 是膨胀且无扭曲的，则有两个子族：剪切为零时对应具有非类光 Maxwell 场的 Robinson-Trautman 电真空解，或者具有类光场的剪切解。最后，当 k 不膨胀时，解约化为已知 Kundt 解的子集。在所有情形中，Chern-Simons 项在壳上恒为零。顺带地，通过放宽对 A 的对齐假设，我们还获得了六维带荷 Taub-NUT 度量的推广，其中场强的磁部分是两个不同 Kähler 2-形式的线性组合，这与先前多于四维的例子不同。
classification.one_liner: 利用广义 Kerr-Schild 变换系统性构造高维 Einstein-Maxwell(-Chern-Simons) 解，并给出带荷 Taub-NUT、Robinson-Trautman 等分支

papers.title: Angular power spectrum of induced gravitational waves: breaking model and parameter degeneracies in PTA observations
papers.abstract: Large primordial curvature and tensor perturbations on small scales can generate second-order tensor-scalar induced gravitational waves (TSIGWs) through scalar-scalar, tensor-scalar, and tensor-tensor source terms. TSIGWs are recognized as one of the principal contributors to the stochastic gravitational wave background (SGWB) observations. We explore the energy density spectrum of second-order TSIGWs in the presence of non-Gaussian primordial curvature perturbations. Furthermore, we present the first calculation of the anisotropic angular power spectrum associated with second-order TSIGWs, which provides a promising tool to discriminate them from other SGWB sources.

classification.title_zh: 诱导引力波的角功率谱：打破PTA观测中的模型与参数简并
classification.abstract_zh: 小尺度上的大原初曲率和张量扰动可以通过标量-标量、张量-标量和张量-张量源项产生二阶张量-标量诱导引力波（TSIGWs）。TSIGW被认为是随机引力波背景（SGWB）观测的主要贡献者之一。我们研究了在存在非高斯原初曲率扰动的情况下二阶TSIGW的能量密度谱。此外，我们首次计算了与二阶TSIGW相关的各向异性角功率谱，这为将它们与其它SGWB源区分开提供了一种有前途的工具。
classification.one_liner: 通过计算诱导引力波的各向异性角功率谱，为PTA观测中区分不同随机引力波背景源提供新手段。

papers.title: Scalar wave scattering by black holes embedded in dark matter halos
papers.abstract: We study the scattering of massless scalar waves by static black holes embedded in dark matter halos. The halo is modelled by means of a Hernquist profile, for which the Einstein equations admit an exact solution. We analyse the scattering using null geodesics, the glory approximation, the partial wave expansion, and the complex angular momentum (CAM) method. The geometric analysis shows that the presence of the halo changes the light ring radius weakly but shifts the critical and glory impact parameters. The wave analysis shows that the characteristic black hole interference pattern is preserved, with halo compactness providing the leading correction and the halo scale radius playing a secondary role. For sufficiently compact halos, the environment also induces a sizeable gravitational redshift. Most of the displacement of the interference extrema can be reproduced by a vacuum Schwarzschild solution with an appropriately chosen $\omega M_{\rm BH}$. A non-vanishing residual, however, reveals a genuine halo contribution that cannot be absorbed into such an effective frequency shift. Finally, we perform the CAM reconstruction of the scattering cross section and find that only a few Regge poles are required to achieve high accuracy at large angles.

classification.title_zh: 暗物质晕内嵌黑洞的标量波散射
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究嵌入暗物质晕中的静态黑洞对无质量标量波的散射。暗物质晕采用Hernquist轮廓建模，该轮廓允许爱因斯坦方程存在精确解。我们利用零测地线、光环近似、分波展开和复角动量（CAM）方法分析散射。几何分析表明，暗物质晕的存在对光环半径影响较弱，但会移动临界碰撞参数和光环碰撞参数。波动分析显示，特征性的黑洞干涉图样得以保持，其中暗物质晕的紧致性起主要修正作用，晕的标度半径起次要作用。对于足够紧致的晕，环境还会引起显著的引力红移。干涉极值的大部分位移可由适当选择 ωM_BH 的真空Schwarzschild解重现。然而，非零残差揭示了无法被这种有效频移吸收的真正晕贡献。最后，我们进行了散射截面的CAM重构，发现仅需少数Regge极点即可在大角度下实现高精度。
classification.one_liner: 利用零测地线、分波展开和复角动量方法研究暗物质晕中黑洞的标量波散射，发现干涉图样基本保持但存在由晕紧致性主导的环境修正。

papers.title: Gravitational Waves from Reheating beyond Instantaneous Thermalization
papers.abstract: We study gravitational-wave production during perturbative reheating without assuming instantaneous thermalization of the inflaton decay products. The injected energetic particles thermalize through an in-medium cascade of nearly collinear splittings subject to the Landau-Pomeranchuk-Migdal effect and are ultimately isotropized by elastic scatterings near the thermal scale. The non-thermal hard population present before complete thermalization produces an additional gravitational-wave component through hard-soft scatterings, with $\Omega_{\mathrm{GW}}\propto f^{1/2}$ below the injection-scale turnover. The same isotropization erases the directional information underlying the vacuum $1/k$ bremsstrahlung soft pole, changing the deep-infrared spectrum from $\Omega_{\mathrm{GW}}\propto f$ to $\Omega_{\mathrm{GW}}\propto f^3$.

classification.title_zh: 超越瞬时热化的再加热阶段引力波产生
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究了在不对暴胀子衰变产物做瞬时热化假设的情况下，扰动性再加热过程中的引力波产生。注入的高能粒子通过受 Landau-Pomeranchuk-Migdal 效应制约的介质内近共线劈裂级联实现热化，并最终在热尺度附近通过弹性散射各向同性化。在完全热化之前存在的非热硬粒子群通过硬-软散射产生额外的引力波成分，在注入尺度转折以下满足 Ω_GW ∝ f^{1/2}。相同的各向同性化抹去了真空 1/k 轫致辐射软极点背后的方向性信息，使深红外谱从 Ω_GW ∝ f 变为 Ω_GW ∝ f^3。
classification.one_liner: 通过考虑暴胀子衰变产物未瞬时热化的扰动再加热过程，发现非热硬粒子群的硬-软散射会产生额外引力波成分，并使深红外谱指数由 f 变为 f^3。

papers.title: Scattering Radiation Emitted Near a Black Hole Horizon
papers.abstract: We study a family of outgoing electromagnetic radiation states prepared outside but arbitrarily close to the horizon of a Schwarzschild black hole, with frequencies that remain uniformly bounded in the local source frame. As the preparation point approaches the horizon, gravitational redshift drives this radiation toward zero Killing frequency and into a controlled soft regime at any fixed exterior scattering radius. The radiation considered here may be viewed as part of the Hawking radiation spectrum. After including transmission through the Schwarzschild potential, we obtain the leading soft response in a localized region of weak curvature and formulate an inclusive scattering probability that is infrared safe. Through the infrared triangle, this response is related to electromagnetic memory at future null infinity. The conditioned memory record probes angular projections of the zero-frequency component of the transmitted radiation, together with their correlations with the accompanying hard scattering outcome. It can therefore provide an additional asymptotic constraint and a partial fingerprint of the radiation source.

classification.title_zh: 黑洞视界附近发射的散射辐射
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究一族在Schwarzschild黑洞视界外侧任意近处制备的外向电磁辐射态，其在局域源参考系中频率保持一致有界。随着制备点靠近视界，引力红移使该辐射趋于零Killing频率，并在任意固定外部散射半径处进入可控软区。这里考虑的辐射可视为霍金辐射谱的一部分。在计及穿过Schwarzschild势垒的透射之后，我们得到了弱曲率局域区域中的领头软响应，并构造了一个红外安全的包含性散射概率。通过红外三角，该响应与未来类光无穷远处的电磁记忆相关联。受条件作用的记忆记录探测透射辐射的零频分量的角投影，及其与伴随硬散射结果的关联。因此，它可以提供额外的渐近约束和辐射源的部分指纹。
classification.one_liner: 研究黑洞视界附近电磁辐射的散射与记忆效应，通过红外三角将软响应与未来类光无穷远的电磁记忆关联，可提供辐射源的渐近探针。
