papers.title: Holographic One-Point Function and Geodesics in SdS$_3$
papers.abstract: Grinberg and Maldacena showed that heavy thermal one-point functions in AdS/CFT can encode complex geodesics reaching a black hole singularity. We study the de Sitter analogue in three-dimensional Schwarzschild--de Sitter space, restricting to the finite cyclic quotients $\mathrm{dS}_3/\mathbb Z_q$. We define a one-point function through a differentiate dictionary and show that an analogous result holds for the Bunch--Davies-prepared integral. Using the exact light field Green function, the bulk integral reduces exactly to a convergent one-dimensional transform, whose large-mass limit is controlled by the near-defect region and governed by a complex saddle. Its action reproduces a complex geodesic length from future infinity to the conical defect, whose real part is the renormalized boundary-to-horizon proper time and whose imaginary part is the horizon-to-defect distance. The imaginary part appears in the one-point coefficient normalized in the Lorentzian source basis; in the Euclidean basis the same saddle contributes only the real part, the two being related by a fixed connection factor.

classification.title_zh: SdS$_3$中的全息单点函数与测地线
classification.abstract_zh: Grinberg和Maldacena指出，AdS/CFT中重的热单点函数可以编码到达黑洞奇点的复测地线。我们在三维Schwarzschild--de Sitter空间中研究其de Sitter类似物，并限制在有限循环商空间$\mathrm{dS}_3/\mathbb Z_q$上。我们通过微分字典定义单点函数，并证明对于Bunch--Davies制备的积分有类似结果成立。利用精确的光场Green函数，体积分精确约化为一个收敛的一维变换，其大质量极限由近缺陷区域控制，并由一个复鞍点支配。其作用量再现了从未来无穷远到锥形缺陷的复测地线长度，其实部是重整化后的边界到视界固有时，虚部是视界到缺陷的距离。虚部出现在Lorentzian源基中归一化的单点系数中；在Euclidean基中，同一鞍点只贡献实部，两者通过一个固定的连接因子联系起来。
classification.one_liner: 在三维Schwarzschild-de Sitter空间中，建立了de Sitter全息单点函数与复测地线长度之间的对应，其大质量极限由近缺陷区的复鞍点控制。
classification.relevance_reason: 该论文主要属于de Sitter全息与测地线对应，不在给定的用户重点标签范围内（如全息超流、QNM、相变等）。

papers.title: Black Hole Interior Operators and Dilatation Symmetry in Planar Black Branes
papers.abstract: Planar AdS black branes have a scaling symmetry that maps a brane solution at one temperature to a solution at another. It is natural to expect that boundary representations of bulk field modes should inherit this symmetry i.e. their correlators should transform covariantly under boundary dilatations. We derive a covariance condition that any boundary representation of interior modes in a planar AdS black brane should satisfy. We then show that Papadodimas-Raju mirror operators satisfy this condition. Thus the Papadodimas-Raju reconstruction of the bulk interior, although state-dependent, inherits the scaling symmetry of planar AdS black holes.

classification.title_zh: 平面 AdS 黑膜中的黑洞内部算子与标度对称性
classification.abstract_zh: 平面 AdS 黑膜具有一种标度对称性，可将某一温度下的膜解映射到另一温度下的解。自然地预期，体场模式的边界表示应继承该对称性，即它们的关联函数应在边界标度变换下协变地变换。我们推导出平面 AdS 黑膜中内部模式的任何边界表示都应满足的协变条件，然后证明 Papadodimas-Raju 镜像算子满足该条件。因此，Papadodimas-Raju 对体内部的态依赖重构继承了平面 AdS 黑洞的标度对称性。
classification.one_liner: 通过推导内部模式的边界表示协变条件，证明 Papadodimas-Raju 镜像算子虽然具有态依赖性，但仍继承平面 AdS 黑膜的标度对称性。
classification.relevance_reason: 该文关注 AdS/CFT 中黑膜内部算子边界表示的标度/膨胀对称性，属于全息体态重构与黑洞量子引力信息方向，但未涉及用户标注的凝聚态、相变或经典引力等具体研究支线。

papers.title: Asymptotic Algebras and Holography of Information in CGHS Model
papers.abstract: Holography of Information (HoI) and the island formula are two recent approaches to the black hole information loss paradox that yield different Page curves. The difference between the Page curves has been argued to be rooted in the algebra that each approach focuses on. In this paper, we study the candidate algebras for the CGHS model. Making the usual assumptions that are made in HoI literature, we establish HoI for the CGHS model coupled to a massless scalar by constructing the radiative phase space and asymptotic algebras at future null infinity. We prove that the quantum state of the right-moving modes can be recovered from an arbitrarily small neighbourhood of the right future null infinity. We then argue that island reconstruction is incompatible with exact commutativity of the left and right radiative algebras. We discuss the possible distinction between the HoI and island approaches for the CGHS model.

classification.title_zh: CGHS模型中的渐近代数与信息全息
classification.abstract_zh: 信息全息（HoI）和岛公式是近年来处理黑洞信息丢失悖论的两种方法，它们得到不同的Page曲线。有观点认为Page曲线的差异源于每种方法所关注的代数。本文研究CGHS模型的候选代数。采用HoI文献中的通常假设，通过在将来零无穷构造辐射相空间和渐近代数，我们建立了与无质量标量场耦合的CGHS模型的HoI。我们证明右行模的量子态可以从右将来零无穷的任意小邻域恢复。然后我们论证岛重建与左右辐射代数的完全交换性不相容。我们讨论HoI与岛方法在CGHS模型中可能的区别。
classification.one_liner: 该文在CGHS二维引力模型中建立信息全息，证明了右行模量子态可由右将来零无穷的任意小领域恢复，并指出岛重建与辐射代数交换性存在张力。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文主题属于量子引力/黑洞信息，与给定的重点研究支线（如全息超流、凝聚态、QNM等）无直接交集。

papers.title: Entropy Quantization and Quasi-normal Modes of Dyonic Kerr-Sen Black Holes
papers.abstract: We explore the properties of inner and outer horizon thermodynamics of dyonic Kerr-Sen black hole (DKSBH). It is observed that the entropy (or area) product is universal, depending only on the angular momentum of the BH. We then proceed to study the dual conformal field theory~(CFT) in the Kerr/CFT correspondence using thermodynamic relations and compute the central charges from 2D CFT. The central charges are found to be universal with only angular momentum dependence. By comparing to Kerr-Newman BH, it is found that the essential difference is in the right-moving sector of the CFT. Interestingly, we can then explicitly produce the non-vanishing central charges related to its static solution, the dyonic dilaton BH, using the thermodynamic method. Moreover, from the CFT relations to multi-horizon thermodynamics, we find the analytical expression of the quasi-normal modes~(QNM) spectra in terms of BH parameters. This QNM computation supports the Bekenstein-Hod conjecture on the BH's entropy quantization.

classification.title_zh: 双荷 Kerr-Sen 黑洞的熵量子化与准正则模
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究了双荷 Kerr-Sen 黑洞（DKSBH）的内外视界热力学性质。研究发现其熵（或面积）乘积是普适的，仅依赖于黑洞角动量。随后，利用热力学关系研究 Kerr/CFT 对应中的对偶共形场论（CFT），并从二维 CFT 计算中心荷，发现中心荷也是普适的，只依赖于角动量。通过与 Kerr-Newman 黑洞比较，发现本质差异位于 CFT 的右行扇区。有趣的是，热力学方法还能显式给出其静态解——双荷伸缩子黑洞——的非零中心荷。此外，从 CFT 关系到多视界热力学，我们得到以黑洞参数表示的准正则模（QNM）谱的解析表达式；该 QNM 计算支持 Bekenstein-Hod 关于黑洞熵量子化的猜想。
classification.one_liner: 对双荷 Kerr-Sen 黑洞，利用内外视界热力学和 Kerr/CFT 对应得到普适中心荷及解析准正则模谱，从而支持 Bekenstein-Hod 熵量子化猜想。
classification.relevance_reason: 该文包含 QNM 谱的解析计算，可与 QNM 研究主线发生交集，但其核心为黑洞熵量子化/Kerr-CFT 热力学，不涉及全息凝聚态、探针膜或非线性演化，因此相关度为中等偏间接。

papers.title: Conformally mapping HKLL to flat space
papers.abstract: We study two conformal images of the HKLL reconstruction problem for a conformally coupled scalar on AdS$_3$. The first mapping is to a Dirichlet problem on one half of the Einstein static universe. A further conformal transformation maps this half-ESU problem to a massless scalar in a region of $(2+1)$-dimensional Minkowski space bounded by an uniformly accelerated circular Dirichlet mirror. However, the global HKLL problem, the resulting flat-space problem is not a generic local mirror problem with arbitrary boundary data. Rather, the mirror response data must belong to a restricted spectral class inherited from normalizable global AdS modes. We formulate and solve this restricted mirror problem intrinsically in flat space. In the process, we find an example of a valid smearing function which itself does not satisfy the equations of motion. We further consider AdS-Rindler wedge reconstruction. By conformal mapping to an appropriate coordinate system in flat space, we find a simple way to see the blow-up of the smearing function.

classification.title_zh: 将 HKLL 共形映射到平直时空
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究了 AdS3 中共形耦合标量的 HKLL 重建问题的两个共形像。第一个映射是爱因斯坦静态宇宙一半上的 Dirichlet 问题。进一步的共形变换将这个半-ESU 问题映射到一个由均匀加速的圆形 Dirichlet 镜面所界定的 (2+1) 维闵可夫斯基空间区域中的无质量标量问题。然而，对于全局 HKLL 问题，得到的平直空间问题并不是具有任意边界数据的一般局部镜面问题；相反，镜面响应数据必须属于从可归一化的全局 AdS 模式继承而来的受限谱类。我们在平直空间中内禀地构造并求解了这个受限镜面问题。在此过程中，我们找到了一个合法的 smearing 函数的例子，而该函数本身并不满足运动方程。我们进一步考虑了 AdS-Rindler 楔形重建：通过共形映射到平直空间中的适当坐标系，我们可以简洁地看到 smearing 函数的发散行为。
classification.one_liner: 通过共形映射研究 AdS3 上 HKLL 体态重建在爱因斯坦静态宇宙与平直空间中的像，并构造受限镜面问题的 smearing 函数。
classification.relevance_reason: 该论文属于 AdS/CFT 字典中的 HKLL 体态重建基础研究，与所列全息超流、相变、QNM 或经典引力等具体支线无直接重叠，因此相关性较低。

papers.title: The Late-time Ramp of the Double-Scaled SYK Model from the large-$n$ tail of Cactus Diagram
papers.abstract: We derive the late-time ramp of the finite-temperature spectral form factor in the double-scaled SYK model directly from cactus diagrams, which is introduced as a multi-trace generalization of chord diagram in Ref \cite{Berkooz:2020fvm}. Although single-trace observables admit an exact chord-diagram description, multi-trace sums are obstructed by the chord-intersection weights $q_{IJ}$, which cannot be averaged independently to $q$. Our key idea is that the non-analytic contribution responsible for the ramp is controlled by the large-order tail of the Cactus-diagram expansion and is insensitive to finite changes in its low-order analytic terms. Decomposing the contribution with $n$-cross-trace-pairings Cactus diagram into two buds $B_n$ and a kernel $\mathcal K_n$, we determine their large-$n$ asymptotics with fixed $0\leq q<1$ and resum the resulting tail. For $\beta_L=\beta+it$ and $\beta_R=\beta-it$, we obtain \begin{equation*} Z_s^{\mathrm{sing}}(\beta+it,\beta-it) =s_p c_N \frac{|t|}{2\pi} \int_{E_{min}}^{E_{max}} e^{-2\beta E} dE+O(1), \qquad s_p=\begin{cases}2,&4\mid p,\\1,&4\nmid p.\end{cases} \end{equation*} This result reproduces the linear ramp predicted by random matrix theory, including its temperature dependence and symmetry factor, and agrees with the semiclassical predictions. It provides a direct microscopic origin of the ramp within the general $q$-deformed quantum algebra. While the plateau lies beyond the scope of the present analysis and calculation.

classification.title_zh: 双标度SYK模型晚期斜坡：来自仙人掌图的大n尾部
classification.abstract_zh: 我们直接从仙人掌图推导了双标度SYK模型中有限温度谱形因子的晚期斜坡，仙人掌图在文献[Berkooz:2020fvm]中被引入为弦图的多迹推广。尽管单迹观测量具有精确的弦图描述，多迹求和受到弦交叉权重q_{IJ}的阻碍，这些权重无法独立地平均为q。我们的关键思想是，产生斜坡的非解析贡献由仙人掌图展开的大阶尾部控制，并且对其低阶解析项的有限改变不敏感。我们将具有n次交叉迹配对的仙人掌图贡献分解为两个萌芽B_n和一个核K_n，确定了它们在固定0≤q<1下的大n渐近行为，并对所得尾部进行重求和。对于β_L=β+it和β_R=β-it，我们得到：Z_s^{sing}(β+it,β-it)=s_p c_N |t|/(2π) ∫_{E_min}^{E_max} e^{-2βE} dE + O(1)，其中s_p=2（若4整除p），1（其他情况）。这一结果再现了随机矩阵理论预言的线性斜坡，包括其温度依赖性和对称因子，并与半经典预言一致。它为一般q变形量子代数中斜坡的直接微观起源提供了依据。而平台则超出了本文分析和计算的范围。
classification.one_liner: 通过仙人掌图大阶尾部的重求和，直接从双标度SYK模型导出有限温度谱形因子的线性斜坡。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文主要处理双标度SYK模型与随机矩阵理论中的谱形因子斜坡问题，与用户关注的全息超流、相变、经典引力等支线的直接关联较弱；仅multi-trace技术与个别用户标签重叠。

papers.title: Primary gravitational waves at high frequencies II: Emergence of the exponential cut-off in the power spectrum
papers.abstract: [Abridged] In slow roll inflation, the power spectrum (PS) of primary gravitational waves (PGWs) generated from the quantum vacuum rises as $k^2$ over wave numbers $k$ which never leave the Hubble radius. In fact, over such small scales, the PS exhibits a similar behavior at any time after inflation. In a recent work, we had argued that the PS of PGWs has to be regularized to truncate the unphysical quadratic rise at large wave numbers. Assuming instantaneous transitions from inflation to the epochs of radiation and matter domination, we had shown that the regularized PS oscillates with a constant amplitude about a vanishing mean over small scales during these epochs. We had also smoothed the transition (actually, the `effective potential' governing the equation of motion of GWs) from inflation to radiation domination using a linear function and evaluated the regularized PS of PGWs post inflation. In such a case, we had shown that, over small scales, while the regularized PS continues to oscillate about zero, its amplitude decreases as $k^{-1}$. In this work, using the Born approximation, we examine the behavior of the regularized PS of PGWs over small scales when they are evolved through smoother and smoother transitions from inflation to the epochs of radiation and matter domination. We illustrate that, at small scales or high frequencies, the suppression in the regularized PS of PGWs occurs more and more sharply as the transition is smoothed further and further. With the help of examples, we also show that, in the case of transitions described by infinitely differentiable `effective potentials', the regularized PS of PGWs exhibits an exponential suppression on small scales. We argue that the observation of the exponential drop in the PS of PGWs can help us determine the energy scale and the time of the end of inflation. We clarify related issues and discuss the wider implications.

classification.title_zh: 高频原初引力波 II：功率谱中指数截断的出现
classification.abstract_zh: （节选）在慢滚暴胀中，源自量子真空的原初引力波功率谱在从未离开哈勃半径的波数k上呈k^2上升。事实上，在这些小尺度上，功率谱在暴胀后的任意时刻都表现出类似行为。我们曾论证必须对原初引力波功率谱进行正则化，以截断大波数处非物理的二次上升。在本文中，我们利用Born近似，研究了当量子真空涨落经历从暴胀到辐射和物质主导时期越来越平滑的过渡时，正则化功率谱在小尺度上的行为。我们证明，当过渡被进一步平滑，小尺度或高频处的抑制会越来越尖锐。通过实例我们还表明，对于由无穷可微“有效势”描述的过渡，原初引力波的正则化功率谱在小尺度上呈现指数压制。我们论证，观测到这种指数下降有助于确定暴胀结束的能量尺度与时间。
classification.one_liner: 通过平滑从暴胀到辐射/物质主导时期的过渡，证明原初引力波功率谱在小尺度上出现指数截断，并可用于测定暴胀结束的能量尺度与时间。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文聚焦于经典引力框架下的宇宙学原初引力波功率谱，与用户关注的经典引力/广义相对论支线直接相关，但与全息、凝聚态等主线无关。

papers.title: Free energy and spectral edge of the SYK model
papers.abstract: We introduce a microscopic framework that gives the first rigorous derivation of the Schwinger--Dyson thermodynamics of the Sachdev--Ye--Kitaev model. For fixed, even interaction order $q\geq 4$, we prove that the annealed and quenched normalized pressures converge to the Schwinger--Dyson pressure $p_{{\rm SD},q}(\beta)$, at any fixed inverse temperature $\beta>0$. The proof is derived from the finite-$N$ Gibbs state, and it contains three new ingredients: a single-site cavity expansion that keeps the bulk Gibbs state intact, a finite-dimensional locality estimate yielding label-uniform conditional factorization of the Euclidean cavity fields, and an exact Majorana-bath representation of the leading diagrams. We further determine the asymptotic location of the largest eigenvalue, which answers a question posed by Feng--Tian--Wei. Consequently, the sample free-energy density converges almost surely to the zero-temperature value along every sequence $\beta\equiv \beta_N\to\infty$.

classification.title_zh: SYK 模型的自由能与谱边
classification.abstract_zh: 我们引入一个微观框架，首次对 Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev 模型的 Schwinger-Dyson 热力学给出严格推导。对于固定偶数相互作用阶数 q≥4，我们证明退火与淬火归一化压强在任意固定逆温度 β>0 下收敛到 Schwinger-Dyson 压强 p_{SD,q}(β)。证明基于有限 N 的 Gibbs 态，包含三个新要素：保持体 Gibbs 态完整的单点空腔展开、给出标签一致条件因子化的有限维局域性估计，以及主图的精确 Majorana 热库表示。我们进一步确定了最大特征值的渐近位置，回答了 Feng-Tian-Wei 提出的问题。因此，样本自由能密度沿任意 β≡β_N→∞ 的序列几乎必然收敛到零温值。
classification.one_liner: 严格证明了 SYK 模型的退火/淬火压强收敛到 Schwinger-Dyson 压强，并确定谱边与自由能密度的零温收敛。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文研究 SYK 模型严格热力学与谱性质，未涉及用户重点标签中的全息超流超导、p 波序参量、畴壁/孤子/涡旋、相变成核、QNM、探针膜或经典引力等方向。

papers.title: Towards a Connection Formulation of Action-Dependent Palatini Gravity
papers.abstract: Previous work has shown that first-order Palatini gravity may be cast as a non-conservative Herglotz Lagrangian field theory, which excludes the conformal mode from its space of dynamical variables. In the present work, we analyse the role of the $SO(1,3)$ gauge connection in the construction of this action-dependent theory. The connection may be algebraically decomposed into complementary sectors which we interpret as `shape' and `scale' components. Only the former is retained within the Herglotz theory, while the latter is incorporated into the action-dependent sector. It is shown that the choice of connection decomposition is a space that can be smoothly parameterised. Such an observation leads to the finding that there exists a `moduli space of frictional field theories', in which each point corresponds to a distinct algebraic splitting of the connection into shape and scale pieces. Movement within the moduli space transitions between Herglotz Lagrangians whose on-shell dynamics all reproduce first-order Palatini gravity. The distinction lies in how the reproduction of the scale dynamics of the original theory is partitioned between action dependence and dynamical torsion.

classification.title_zh: 走向作用依赖的Palatini引力的联络表述
classification.abstract_zh: 先前工作表明，一阶Palatini引力可以表述为非保守的Herglotz拉格朗日场论，该理论从其动力学变量空间中排除了共形模式。在本文中，我们分析了SO(1,3)规范联络在此作用依赖理论构建中的作用。联络可代数分解为互补的扇区，我们将其诠释为“形状”和“标度”分量。在Herglotz理论中仅保留前者，而后者并入作用依赖扇区。结果表明，联络分解的选择空间可以被平滑参数化。这一观察引出了“摩擦场论模空间”的存在，其中每个点对应联络在形状与标度部分之间的不同代数分割。模空间内的运动在不同Herglotz拉格朗日之间转换，它们的在壳动力学均复现一阶Palatini引力。其区别在于原始理论标度动力学的复现方式如何被划分到作用依赖与动力学挠率之间。
classification.one_liner: 本文研究作用依赖Palatini引力中SO(1,3)联络的分解，发现存在一个“摩擦场论模空间”，其中不同分割方式均复现一阶Palatini引力的动力学。
classification.relevance_reason: 该论文属于经典引力理论（作用依赖的Palatini引力）的形式研究，不涉及全息对偶或量子引力，但与用户关注的经典引力/广义相对论研究线直接相关。

papers.title: A NICER view of PSR J1614$-$2230: a massive and compact millisecond pulsar
papers.abstract: Using pulse profile modeling, we obtain the mass-radius measurement of a millisecond pulsar (MSP) with data from the Neutron Star Interior Composition ExploreR, XMM-Newton and the Chandra X-ray Observatory. We report here the radius of PSR J1614$-$2230, the second most massive MSP confirmed by radio timing. All of the data sets are well described by a simple model composed of two circular hot spots. The final result yields an equatorial radius of $R_{\rm eq}=10.06 ^{+1.25}_{-0.87}\,$km, and a gravitational mass of $M=1.937^{+0.012}_{-0.013}\,M_{\odot}$ (equally tailed 68% credible intervals). Although a non-thermal component was previously reported at higher energies, we find no sign of it in either our phase-averaged or phase-resolved spectral analyses. Using new relations linking the compactness to oblateness or surface gravity, and tailored to the spin frequency of PSR J1614$-$2230, we infer a configuration with one hot spot near the pole, and another near the equator. The tight mass posterior is essentially informed by radio timing, while the radius constraint is not as tight due to the low source signal (8.5$\sigma$ X-ray pulse significance). However, over all geometries and atmosphere models tested, the radius posterior tends toward low values ($\lesssim12.08\,$km, 90th percentile in all cases).

classification.title_zh: NICER 视角下的 PSR J1614−2230：一颗大质量且致密的毫秒脉冲星
classification.abstract_zh: 利用脉冲轮廓建模，我们使用中子星内部成分探测器（NICER）、XMM-Newton 和钱德拉 X 射线天文台的数据，获得了毫秒脉冲星 PSR J1614−2230 的质量-半径测量结果。所有数据集均可由两个圆形热斑组成的简单模型很好地描述。最终结果给出赤道半径 R_eq=10.06^{+1.25}_{-0.87} km，引力质量 M=1.937^{+0.012}_{-0.013} M⊙（68% 等尾可信区间）。尽管此前有报道称在更高能段存在非热成分，但我们在相位平均和相位分辨光谱分析中均未发现其迹象。利用将紧致度与扁率或表面引力联系起来并针对该源自转频率定制的新关系，我们推断出一个热斑靠近极区、另一个靠近赤道的构型。质量后验主要由射电计时约束，半径约束因 X 射线脉冲显著性较低（8.5σ）而不太紧；然而在所有测试的几何结构和大气模型中，半径后验均倾向于低值（第 90 百分位 ≤12.08 km）。
classification.one_liner: 通过对 NICER 等望远镜的脉冲轮廓建模，给出毫秒脉冲星 PSR J1614−2230 的质量和半径测量，其半径偏小，表明致密且质量大。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文专注于中子星观测和经典引力下的质量-半径约束，与理论全息、AdS/CFT 或量子引力无关，仅与经典引力/广义相对论中的致密星体相关。

papers.title: Equation of state and neutron star properties with new mass-radius constraints from PSR~J1614--2230, PSR~J2124--3358, and 47~Tuc~X7
papers.abstract: We study the impact of new mass-radius information from PSR J1614-2230, PSR J2124-3358, and 47 Tuc X7 in a combined equation of state inference based on chiral effective field theory constraints at nuclear densities and using different high-density extensions, including perturbative QCD constraints. The largest impact stems from the heavy-mass PSR J1614-2230 star, which shifts heavy neutron stars to smaller radii by around 0.4 km. Moreover, the combined astrophysical NICER, LIGO/Virgo, and X-ray information drives the radius posterior to a more data-driven distribution, which is less sensitive to the high-density extension. For the equation of state, the new mass-radius information significantly tightens the pressure and speed-of-sound posterior distributions, especially around three times saturation density. Finally, we make predictions for the poorly constrained masses of PSR J2124-3358 and 47 Tuc X7 based on the combined equation of state analysis and the other astrophysical sources.

classification.title_zh: 状态方程与中子星性质：来自PSR J1614-2230、PSR J2124-3358和47 Tuc X7的新质量-半径约束
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究了来自PSR J1614-2230、PSR J2124-3358和47 Tuc X7的新质量-半径信息对联合状态方程推断的影响，该推断基于核密度下的手征有效场论约束，并采用不同的高密度扩展，包括微扰QCD约束。最大的影响来自重质量PSR J1614-2230星，它使重中子星的半径减小约0.4公里。此外，结合NICER、LIGO/Virgo和X射线的天体物理信息，使半径后验分布更趋于数据驱动，并对高密度扩展的敏感性降低。对于状态方程而言，新的质量-半径信息显著收紧了压强和声速的后验分布，尤其是在约三倍饱和密度处。最后，我们基于联合状态方程分析和其它天体物理源，对约束较差的PSR J2124-3358和47 Tuc X7的质量进行了预测。
classification.one_liner: 利用来自脉冲星的新质量-半径观测与核物理约束，得到更紧致的中子星状态方程推论。
classification.relevance_reason: 该论文主要研究中子星物态方程与质量-半径关系，属于经典引力背景下致密天体物理应用，而非广义相对论基本理论或全息研究；与重点标签中的经典引力有一定交集。

papers.title: Magnetic-type Love number differentiating quark stars from neutron stars
papers.abstract: The quark star (QS) is a hypothetical and yet undiscovered stellar object, and its existence would mark a paradigm shift in research on nuclear and quark matter. Although compactness is a well-known signature for distinguishing between two branches of QSs and neutron stars (NSs), some QSs can overlap with NSs in the radius-mass plane. To manifest their evident differences, we investigate the tidal properties of QSs and NSs. We then find that the magnetic-type Love number is a robust indicator for differentiating between QSs and NSs, whereas the electric-type one is insufficient when QSs and NSs have similar masses and radii. Finally, we show that gravitational waves from binary star mergers can, in principle, be sensitive to differences between QSs and NSs.

classification.title_zh: 磁型Love数区分夸克星与中子星
classification.abstract_zh: 夸克星（QS）是一种假设且尚未发现的恒星天体，其存在将标志着核物质和夸克物质研究的范式转变。尽管紧致度是区分两类QS与中子星（NS）的已知特征，但一些QS在半径-质量平面上可能与NS重叠。为揭示其明显差异，我们研究了QS和NS的潮汐性质。我们发现磁型Love数是区分QS和NS的稳健指标，而当QS和NS具有相似质量和半径时，电型Love数则不够充分。最后，我们表明来自双星并合的引力波原则上可以对QS与NS之间的差异敏感。
classification.one_liner: 研究表明磁型Love数能稳健区分夸克星与中子星，而电型Love数在质量和半径相似时不足以区分，且引力波原则上可探测其差异。
classification.relevance_reason: 研究属于经典引力/广义相对论中致密天体潮汐变形与引力波相关主题，且用户明确关注经典引力/广义相对论支线。

papers.title: Gravitational waves from core collapse of rotating very-massive stars: 3D numerical relativity computation
papers.abstract: We numerically study the collapse of rotating, very-massive stellar cores with masses of $\approx 200$, $300$, $500$, and $1100M_\odot$ into black holes using both axisymmetric and three-dimensional (3D) numerical relativity. Our results indicate that when the dimensionless spin of the resulting black hole exceeds 0.8, a massive disk consistently forms around it. These massive, compact disks, carrying more than about 10\% of the black hole's mass, are prone to non-axisymmetric deformations that trigger gravitational-wave bursts with frequencies around 10-50 Hz. Such waves could be detected by the Einstein Telescope and Cosmic Explorer, even from sources a few Gpc away. We also summarize the gravitational-wave signals from axisymmetric collapse, which tend to have lower amplitudes and higher frequencies than those caused by non-axisymmetric instabilities.

classification.title_zh: 旋转超大规模恒星核心坍缩的引力波：三维数值相对论计算
classification.abstract_zh: 我们利用轴对称和三维（3D）数值相对论方法，数值研究了质量约为200、300、500和1100倍太阳质量的旋转超大规模恒星核心坍缩成黑洞的过程。结果表明，当所得黑洞的无量纲自旋超过0.8时，周围会持续形成一个巨大盘。这些巨大致密的盘，携带超过黑洞质量约10%的物质，容易发生非轴对称不稳定性，触发频率约为10-50 Hz的引力波暴。即使在几Gpc外，这类波也能被爱因斯坦望远镜和宇宙探索者探测到。我们还总结了轴对称坍缩产生的引力波信号，这些信号往往具有比非轴对称不稳定性引起的引力波更低的振幅和更高的频率。
classification.one_liner: 通过三维数值相对论模拟揭示了旋转超大规模恒星坍缩成黑洞时，形成大质量吸积盘并产生10-50 Hz引力波暴。
classification.relevance_reason: 该研究与全息/量子引力无关，属于经典数值相对论与引力波天体物理。

papers.title: A Fast and Scalable Transformer Pipeline for Binary Black Hole Detection
papers.abstract: With the projected increase in the detection rate of compact-binary coalescences in the coming decade, there is critical need to develop fast, robust, and scalable alternatives to matched filtering for gravitational-wave searches. Transformer models have revolutionized natural language and audio processing but their application to gravitational-wave astronomy is still largely unexplored. In this work, we introduce \castor, a transformer-based coincident search pipeline for detecting binary black hole gravitational-wave signals from Advanced LIGO detectors. One of the major features of our model is that it allows the false-alarm rate to be estimated via time slides cheaply without requiring repeated evaluations of the neural network. We evaluate \castor\ on datasets from the Machine-Learning Gravitational-Wave Search Challenge (MLGWSC-1) and on approximately five months of real O3b observing strain. When tested on benchmark datasets, \castor\ ranks among the most sensitive machine-learning pipelines and successfully recovers the majority of confident events from the GWTC-3 catalog that lie within its training range. We also benchmark \castor\ against another transformer architecture, GW-Whisper, a domain-adaptation of OpenAI's audio foundation model. We find that \castor\ substantially outperforms the repurposed audio model in sensitivity and also reduces the computational cost of background estimation by a factor of 20. Our results demonstrate a highly practical, scalable approach for deep-learning gravitational wave searches and empirical background estimation for future observing runs.

classification.title_zh: 用于双黑洞探测的快速可扩展Transformer流水线
classification.abstract_zh: 随着下一年代致密双星并合探测率的预期增长，迫切需要开发快速、稳健且可扩展的匹配滤波替代方案用于引力波搜索。Transformer模型已经彻底改变了自然语言和音频处理，但在引力波天文学中的应用基本尚未探索。在这项工作中，我们介绍了CASTRO，一个基于Transformer的符合搜索流水线，用于从Advanced LIGO探测器的双黑洞引力波信号。我们模型的主要特点之一是可以通过时间平移低成本估计误报率，而无需重复评估神经网络。我们在机器学习引力波搜索挑战（MLGWSC-1）数据集以及约五个月的O3b真实观测应变上评估了CASTRO。在基准数据集上测试时，CASTRO在大多数敏感的机器学习流水线中位居前列，并成功恢复了GWTC-3星表中其训练范围内的多数可靠事件。我们还将CASTRO与另一个Transformer架构GW-Whisper进行了基准比较，后者是OpenAI音频基础模型的领域适配。我们发现CASTRO在灵敏度上大幅优于这种改造后的音频模型，并将背景估计的计算成本降低了20倍。我们的结果展示了一种高度实用、可扩展的引力波深度学习搜索及经验背景估计方法，适用于未来的观测运行。
classification.one_liner: 提出CASTRO，一种基于Transformer的双黑洞引力波探测流水线，利用时间滑动高效估计误报率，在基准和真实数据上性能优异。
classification.relevance_reason: 该论文关注引力波信号的深度学习检测与背景估计，属于经典引力实验数据分析，与全息理论或经典引力理论本身无直接关联。

papers.title: Directional Response Optimization through Linear Recombination of Time-Delay Interferometry Channels in Space-based Gravitational Wave Detection
papers.abstract: Space-based gravitational-wave detectors such as LISA, Taiji, and TianQin employ time-delay interferometry (TDI) to cancel laser-frequency noise for unequal-arm constellations. Since different TDI observables exhibit distinct sky responses, a linear combination of candidate channels can enhance the average response over one sky region while suppressing that of another. We construct a frequency-domain response matrix for TDI combinations, average it across target and suppressed sky regions, and derive the optimal weights via a generalized eigenvalue problem that maximizes the ratio between these two regional responses. At millihertz frequencies, examples with the $A$, $E$, and $T$ channels, the Sagnac combinations $\alpha$, $\beta$, and $\gamma$, and 16-links TDI show that a sky-region null and a large regional contrast are possible near the chosen frequency, with eigenvalues $\rho$ ranging from $\mathcal{O}(10)$ for small bases to $\mathcal{O}(10^2)$ for the larger set. The method is therefore expected to be well suited to nearly monochromatic sources such as the resolved Galactic double white dwarf binaries in the millihertz band. The Target-to-Suppression Ratio (TSR) peaks near the design frequency and falls quickly away from it, so the optimized weight vector is inherently narrowband and suited to targeted searches around a chosen frequency and sky direction.

classification.title_zh: 空间引力波探测中通过时间延迟干涉通道线性重组实现方向响应优化
classification.abstract_zh: LISA、Taiji 与 TianQin 等空间引力波探测器使用时间延迟干涉(TDI)来消除不等臂星座中的激光频率噪声。不同 TDI 观测量具有不同的天区响应，因此候选通道的线性组合可以增强某个天区的平均响应并抑制另一个天区。本文构造了 TDI 组合的频域响应矩阵，在目标天区和被抑制天区上取平均，并通过一个最大化这两个区域响应之比的广义本征值问题得到最优权重。在毫赫兹频率下，使用 A、E、T 通道、Sagnac 组合 α、β、γ 以及 16 链路 TDI 的示例表明，在所选频率附近可以实现天区零点和大区域对比；本征值 ρ 对于小基组约为 O(10)，对于大基组约为 O(10^2)。因此，该方法预期很适合近单色源，例如毫赫兹波段中可分辨的银河系双白矮星。目标对抑制比(TSR)在设计频率处达到峰值并随远离频率而快速下降，所以优化后的权重向量本质上是窄带的，适合在选定频率和天空方向附近进行定向搜索。
classification.one_liner: 通过线性组合TDI通道并求解广义本征值问题，可增强空间引力波探测器对目标天区的响应、压制其他区域，形成适合毫赫兹单色源的窄带定向探测。
classification.relevance_reason: 该文属于空间引力波探测的数据分析与探测器响应优化方法，虽可纳入引力波应用方向，但核心内容不涉及全息、量子引力或强耦合理论，与用户主要关注的理论研究支线关联较弱。

papers.title: Polarization Images of Neutron Stars Illuminated by a Thin Accretion Disk: A Comparison with Black Holes
papers.abstract: We investigate linear polarization images of static, spherically symmetric neutron stars illuminated by a geometrically and optically thin accretion disk. Neutron star equilibrium configurations are constructed with a polytropic equation of state, and the null geodesic equations and the parallel transport equation for the linear polarization vector are solved in the geometric optics approximation. The numerical results show that the total polarized intensity is generally positively correlated with the total intensity and reaches its maximum near the neutron star surface. As the observer inclination increases, the symmetry of the polarization images is progressively broken. In addition, the magnetic field configuration mainly affects the direction of the polarization vectors, while its influence on the overall polarized intensity distribution is comparatively limited. To further characterize the spatial structure of the polarization direction, we introduce the net electric vector position angle $\chi_{\mathrm{net}}$ and the second azimuthal Fourier mode $\angle\beta_2$. A comparison with polarization images of a Schwarzschild black hole reveals clear differences between the two types of compact objects in the locations of strongly polarized regions and the size of the central region without a polarization signal. These results show that linear polarization images provide information beyond total intensity images for distinguishing neutron stars from black holes.

classification.title_zh: 薄吸积盘照明下中子星的偏振图像：与黑洞的比较
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究了由几何薄且光学薄的吸积盘照明的静态、球对称中子星的线偏振图像。利用多方物态方程构建中子星平衡位形，并在几何光学近似下求解零测地线方程和线偏振矢量的平行输运方程。数值结果表明，总偏振强度通常与总强度呈正相关，并在中子星表面附近达到最大。随着观测者倾角增大，偏振图像的对称性逐渐被打破。此外，磁场位型主要影响偏振矢量的方向，而对整体偏振强度分布的影响相对有限。为进一步刻画偏振方向的空间结构，我们引入了净电矢量位置角χ_net和二阶方位角傅里叶模角β_2。与Schwarzschild黑洞偏振图像的比较显示，两类致密天体在强偏振区域位置和中心无偏振信号区域大小上存在明显差异。这些结果表明，线偏振图像可提供超出总强度图像的额外信息，用于区分中子星与黑洞。
classification.one_liner: 对薄吸积盘照明的静态球对称中子星做线偏振成像计算，并与Schwarzschild黑洞对比，发现偏振信号的空间分布可作为区分两类致密天体的新探针。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文研究的是经典广义相对论下中子星与黑洞的吸积盘偏振成像，属于用户关注的‘经典引力/广义相对论’支线。

papers.title: Constraining AGN Disk Properties with Gravitational Waves from Inspiraling Stellar-Mass Binary Black Holes in Hierarchical Triple Systems
papers.abstract: Space-based gravitational-wave detectors can observe stellar-mass binary black holes (BBHs) long before merger, allowing weak environmental perturbations to accumulate. For binaries embedded in active galactic nucleus (AGN) disks, the local gas density characterizes the environment of the supermassive black hole (SMBH) and compact-object migration. We study whether such signals can constrain this density when a stellar-mass BBH orbits a Kerr SMBH. We evolve the outer orbit with relativistic corrections and gaseous dynamical friction (DF), and construct the detector-frame waveform including BBH inspiral, de Sitter precession, DF phase correction, and moving-source effects. Using Fisher-matrix calculations for sampled systems, we estimate statistical uncertainties and systematic errors. Larger gas densities generally improve the statistical precision of several source and outer-orbit parameters, but also increase systematic errors when DF is omitted. For favorable GW190521-like systems observed by LISA for one year, the disk density can be constrained at the level of $\sigma_{\rho}\sim10^{-12}\text{--}10^{-10}\,{\rm g\,cm^{-3}}$. Such constraints would connect BBH merger environments to the gas structure of galactic nuclei and the conditions that support black hole growth. These results indicate that hierarchical BBH inspirals can probe AGN disk environments, provided that gas effects are modeled consistently.

classification.title_zh: 利用层级三星系统中旋近恒星质量双黑洞的引力波约束AGN盘性质
classification.abstract_zh: 空间引力波探测器可以在恒星质量双黑洞并合前很久就观测到它们，使微弱的环境扰动得以积累。对于嵌入活动星系核（AGN）盘中的双黑洞，局部气体密度表征了超大质量黑洞（SMBH）的环境以及致密天体迁移。我们研究当恒星质量双黑洞绕一个Kerr超大质量黑洞运行时，这样的信号能否约束该密度。我们考虑相对论修正和气体动力学摩擦来演化外轨道，并构建探测器帧波形，包括双黑洞旋近、de Sitter进动、动力学摩擦相位修正和运动源效应。利用采样系统的Fisher矩阵计算，我们估计统计不确定性和系统误差。较大的气体密度通常提高几个源和外轨道参数的统计精度，但当忽略动力学摩擦时会增加系统误差。对于有利的类似GW190521的系统被LISA观测一年，盘密度可以被约束在σ_ρ~10^-12到10^-10 g/cm^3的水平。这样的约束将把双黑洞并合环境与星系核的气体结构以及支持黑洞增长的条件联系起来。这些结果表明层级双黑洞旋近可以探测AGN盘环境，前提是气体效应得到一致建模。
classification.one_liner: 该研究利用空间引力波探测器如LISA对AGN盘中层级三星系统内双黑洞旋近的观测，通过Fisher矩阵分析表明可约束盘密度。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典引力/广义相对论框架下的引力波天体物理应用，与用户经典引力支线相关，但不涉及全息、量子引力或凝聚态等核心方向。

papers.title: Deviations from Kerr: Polar critical curves and photon rings in a class of separable spacetimes
papers.abstract: Black-hole critical curves and photon rings provide complementary probes of strong-field geometry, motivating a unified analytic description of these observables beyond Kerr and a direct comparison with the Kerr predictions. We develop such a description for polar observers in a radial class of stationary, axisymmetric spacetimes with separable null geodesics. The spacetime dependence is organized through natural optical combinations selected by the null dynamics and a Kerr-relative representation suited to weak deviations from Kerr. We derive compact exact expressions for the polar critical radius, Lyapunov exponent, time delay, and rotation parameter, together with general first-order formulas that can be applied once the deformation functions of a specific metric are supplied. The weak-deviation analysis shows that the combined polar observables probe only a finite set of local deformation values and radial derivatives at the critical orbit, rather than the full radial profiles.

classification.title_zh: 偏离Kerr：一类可分离时空中的极向临界曲线和光子环
classification.abstract_zh: 黑洞临界曲线和光子环为强场几何提供互补的探针，激发了对超越Kerr的这些观测量进行统一解析描述，并与Kerr预言直接比较。我们针对具有可分离零测地线的径向类稳态轴对称时空中的极向观测者发展了这种描述。时空依赖性通过由零动力学和相对于Kerr的表示选择的自然光学组合来组织，适用于弱偏离Kerr的情形。我们推导了极向临界半径、Lyapunov指数、时间延迟和旋转参数的紧凑精确表达式，以及一旦给定特定度规的形变函数即可应用的一般一阶公式。弱偏离分析表明，组合的极向观测量仅探测临界轨道处有限的一组局部形变值及其径向导数，而非完整的径向分布。
classification.one_liner: 在可分离时空类中给出了极向光子临界曲线和光子环偏离Kerr的统一解析公式，表明弱偏离观测量仅依赖临界轨道的局部形变信息。

papers.title: Gravitational-wave signatures of primordial black hole clusters and the imprint of an early dense-core collapse
papers.abstract: Primordial black holes (PBHs) are expected to be born essentially non-spinning and, if the primordial curvature fluctuations possess non-Gaussian tails, strongly clustered. Any spin measured in a PBH population must therefore be dynamically generated. Using direct $N$-body simulations with \textsc{nbody6++gpu}, modified to treat nearly parabolic dynamical-capture mergers, we quantify the conditions under which an initially non-spinning PBH cluster develops the spin, mass and stochastic-background signatures that gravitational-wave observations are now sensitive to. We find a sharp tension: producing a root-mean-square spin $\chi_{\rm rms}\sim0.1 - 0.2$ in the $30 - 50\,M_\odot$ range requires initial Plummer radii of order $10^{-5}\,{\rm pc}$, whereas survival over cosmological times requires parsec-scale clusters. This tension is resolved naturally if PBHs form with a compact, short-lived core embedded in an extended halo, and we therefore simulate the two regimes as independent blocks. The core block ($4000$ PBHs, Plummer radii $3\times10^{-6} - 10^{-4}\,{\rm pc}$) collapses in days to years, producing a burst of mergers whose orbits are strongly non-circular ($e\to1$) and of low dimensionless orbital angular momentum, so that remnant spins are systematically below the quasi-circular value $\chi\simeq0.7$. Redshifted from their formation epoch, the core mergers deposit a stochastic background peaking in the $10^{-6}$--$10^{-4}\,{\rm Hz}$ band accessible to LISA. The picture predicts a specific division of labour between observables, spins set in the primordial collapse, detectable mergers set by the long-term halo, and a two-component stochastic background, and, in particular, that both the spin and the mass data favour a primordial mass function truncated near $50\,M_\odot$.

classification.title_zh: 原初黑洞星团的引力波信号与早期致密核坍缩的印记
classification.abstract_zh: 原初黑洞（PBH）预计在诞生时几乎不携带自旋，而如果原初曲率扰动具有非高斯尾部，它们会强烈成团。因此，在PBH族群中测量到的任何自旋都必然通过动力学过程产生。我们使用经修改以处理近抛物线动力学俘获并合的N体模拟程序nbody6++gpu，直接量化了初始无自旋PBH星团在什么条件下会发展出引力波观测如今已能探测的自旋、质量以及随机背景特征。我们发现一个尖锐的张力：要在30–50太阳质量范围内产生均方根自旋χ_rms~0.1–0.2，需要约10^-5 pc量级的初始Plummer半径；而要在宇宙学时间尺度上存活，则需要秒差距尺度的星团。若PBH形成时带有嵌入延展晕中的致密、短寿命核心，这一张力可自然得到解决，因此我们把这两个区域作为独立模块分别模拟。核心模块（4000个PBH，Plummer半径3×10^-6–10^-4 pc）在数天到数年内坍缩，产生轨道高度非圆（e→1）、无量纲轨道角动量较低的并合爆发，因此残余自旋系统地低于准圆值χ≃0.7。从形成时期红移后，核心并合产生的随机背景峰值落在10^-6–10^-4 Hz频段，可被LISA探测。该图景预见了可观测效应之间明确的分工：自旋在原初坍缩中确定，可探测并合由长期延展晕决定，随机背景则为双组分结构；并且，自旋与质量数据都倾向于支持在约50太阳质量处截断的原初质量函数。
classification.one_liner: N体模拟显示，带致密短寿命核心的原初黑洞星团可同时解释观测所需的自旋与LISA频段随机引力波背景，并暗示质量函数约在50太阳质量截断。

papers.title: Enabling gravitational-wave astronomy with spin-precessing black holes on generic orbits
papers.abstract: Binary black holes (BBHs) formed in dense stellar environments or in hierarchical triples can coalesce on eccentric orbits and carry spins of arbitrary orientation, leaving distinctive imprints on their gravitational-wave (GW) emission. We present SEOBNRv6EPHM: the first generic-orbit, spin-precessing model in the effective-one-body SEOBNR family, whose waveforms have underpinned LIGO-Virgo GW analyses since 2011. The model describes the dynamics and multipolar GW signal of generic BBHs, covering the inspiral-merger-ringdown of coalescing binaries and extending to dynamical captures and scattering encounters. We perform the first systematic accuracy assessment of a generic-orbit model against numerical relativity (NR) waveforms of spin-precessing BBHs, using 1437 quasi-circular (QC) and 87 eccentric simulations: median waveform mismatches remain below $1 \%$, matching the accuracy of the QC model SEOBNRv5PHM, and improving on the state-of-the-art generic-orbit model TEOBResumS-Dal\'i by a median factor of $ 4 $. The model also reproduces the non-perturbative phenomenology observed in NR simulations of generic-spin BBH scattering. It is $\sim 2 - 3$ times faster than SEOBNRv5PHM in the QC limit, and up to an order of magnitude faster than TEOBResumS-Dal\'i, bringing eccentric inference to the cost of current QC analyses. As a proof of principle, we analyze eleven GW events and focus on GW200129, strengthening its evidence for eccentricity $-$ a result supported by injection-recovery studies with synthetic NR signals of eccentric, spin-precessing BBHs. SEOBNRv6EPHM thus enables, for the first time, accurate and efficient GW analyses that jointly account for eccentricity and spin precession.

classification.title_zh: 实现自旋进动黑洞在一般轨道上的引力波天文学
classification.abstract_zh: 在致密恒星环境或层级三星系统中形成的双黑洞（BBH）可以在偏心轨道上合并，并携带任意方向的自旋，从而在其引力波（GW）发射上留下独特印记。我们提出了SEOBNRv6EPHM：有效单体SEOBNR家族中首个通用轨道、自旋进动模型，该家族的波形自2011年以来一直支撑LIGO-Virgo引力波分析。该模型描述了通用BBH的动力学和多极引力波信号，涵盖合并双星的旋进-合并-衰荡，并扩展到动力学捕获和散射遭遇。我们首次对自旋进动BBH的数值相对论（NR）波形进行了通用轨道模型的系统精度评估，使用1437个准圆（QC）和87个偏心模拟：中位波形失配保持在1%以下，与QC模型SEOBNRv5PHM的精度相当，并比最先进的通用轨道模型TEOBResumS-Dal'i提高中位因子4。该模型还再现了在一般自旋BBH散射的NR模拟中观察到的非微扰现象。在QC极限下，它比SEOBNRv5PHM快约2-3倍，比TEOBResumS-Dal'i快达一个数量级，使偏心推断的成本达到当前QC分析的水平。作为原理验证，我们分析了11个引力波事件并聚焦于GW200129，加强了其偏心率的证据——这一结果得到了使用偏心、自旋进动BBH的合成NR信号的注入-恢复研究的支持。因此，SEOBNRv6EPHM首次实现了准确且高效的引力波分析，可同时考虑偏心率和自旋进动。
classification.one_liner: 提出首个通用轨道自旋进动有效单体引力波模型SEOBNRv6EPHM，精度高且计算快，可同时分析偏心与自旋进动双黑洞。

papers.title: Detectability-Aware Screening of Post-Merger Gravitational-Wave Damping Anomalies in Real Detector Noise: A Graph-Spectral Approach with Empirical Null Calibration
papers.abstract: A two-stage methodological proof of concept for screening simplified post-merger gravitational-wave damping anomalies in real LIGO Livingston noise is presented. The injected signal is a controlled damped-sinusoid proxy rather than a physically complete binary-neutron-star post-merger waveform; it is used to test statistical detectability and damping-time scoring under real-noise calibration. Stage 1 constructs a local time-frequency graph from Constant-Q representations of whitened candidate windows and uses the leading eigenvalue as a detectability statistic, with its null distribution calibrated empirically on real detector noise. Stage 2 estimates an effective damping-time score for Stage-1-passing candidates using nonlinear least squares and an interpretable ridge/energy-decay estimator, with thresholds fixed before final held-out evaluation. The matched-filter SNR convention is checked with synthetic Gaussian noise, while the graph statistic is assessed through power-comparison and tile-shuffling tests. On a held-out real-noise test block, the nonlinear least-squares Stage-2 score gives AUC = 0.943 and TPR = 0.879 at FPR = 0.012, outperforming a calibrated power-only baseline.

classification.title_zh: 真实探测器噪声中并合后引力波阻尼异常的检测感知筛选：图谱方法与经验零校准
classification.abstract_zh: 本文针对真实 LIGO Livingston 噪声中并合后引力波阻尼异常的筛选，展示了一个两阶段的统计学方法学概念验证。注入信号为受控的阻尼正弦代理，而非物理上完整的双中子星并合后波形；该信号用于在真实噪声校准条件下测试统计可检测性和阻尼时间评分。第一阶段从白化候选窗口的 Constant-Q 表示构造局部时频图，并以最大特征值作为可检测性统计量，其零分布基于真实探测器噪声经验校准。第二阶段对通过第一阶段筛选的候选样本，使用非线性最小二乘和可解释的岭/能量衰减估计器估计有效阻尼时间评分，阈值在最终留出评估前固定。匹配滤波器信噪比约定通过合成高斯噪声检验；图统计量则通过功效比较和瓦片洗牌检验评估。在留出的真实噪声测试块上，非线性最小二乘第二阶段评分的 AUC=0.943，在 FPR=0.012 时 TPR=0.879，优于经校准的仅功率基线。
classification.one_liner: 提出一种基于时频图谱主特征值与经验零分布的两阶段方法，在真实 LIGO 噪声中筛选并合后阻尼异常代理信号，并取得优于功率基线的检测性能。

papers.title: Dimensional reduction associated with unchanged direction trajectories in flat fiber Robertson Walker spacetimes
papers.abstract: In this article, we establish a new dimensional reduction result in (Galilean or Lorentzian) Robertson Walker spacetimes with Euclidean fiber. In this context, we prove that every unchanged direction observer can be embedded into a three dimensional totally geodesic timelike submanifold.

papers.title: The Radius of the Neutron Star PSR J0614-3329 from NICER Data
papers.abstract: Neutron star radius measurements, particularly using X-ray data collected with the Neutron star Interior Composition Explorer (NICER), have provided invaluable information for models of cold, catalyzed matter at densities above that of nuclear saturation. Here we present an analysis of NICER data on the 318-Hz pulsar PSR J0614-3329, which has a mass ~1.4-1.5 solar masses determined from radio observations. The best-fitting model we explore has three uniform-temperature circular hot spots and yields a symmetric 68% credible range for the equatorial circumferential radius of 9.88-12.77 km. We also explore joint fits to the NICER data and the X-ray Multi-Mirror (XMM-Newton) data on this pulsar, but find that the models that best fit both data sets systematically underpredict the XMM-Newton data when, as is standard, it is assumed that the XMM-Newton background is known from observations of surrounding fields. Finally, we discuss the implications of our results, combined with data on other neutron stars, for the properties of the dense matter in neutron star cores.

classification.title_zh: 基于NICER数据的脉冲星PSR J0614-3329的半径测量
classification.abstract_zh: 中子星半径测量，特别是利用中子星内部组成探测器（NICER）收集的X射线数据，为核饱和密度以上的冷催化物质模型提供了宝贵信息。本文分析了NICER对318赫兹脉冲星PSR J0614-3329的数据，该脉冲星的质量由射电观测确定为约1.4-1.5太阳质量。我们探索的最佳拟合模型具有三个均匀温度的圆形热斑，并给出赤道周向半径的对称68%置信区间为9.88-12.77公里。我们还探索了联合拟合该脉冲星的NICER数据和X射线多镜（XMM-Newton）数据，但发现当按照标准假设XMM-Newton背景可由周围场观测得知时，最佳拟合两个数据集模型会系统性地低估XMM-Newton数据。最后，我们讨论了这些结果结合其他中子星数据对中子星核心致密物质性质的启示。
classification.one_liner: 该论文通过NICER数据测量中子星PSR J0614-3329的半径为9.88-12.77公里，并讨论了其对致密物质性质的影响。

papers.title: Timing of echoes in electromagnetic radiation from hot spots orbiting a Kerr black hole impostor
papers.abstract: We investigate the light curve of an isolated bright spot in a Keplerian orbit around a Kerr black hole candidate to probe possible deviations from the standard event-horizon picture. In particular, we explore the presence of a reflective surface, namely a "mirror" near the horizon, and its observable consequences. We present estimates on the time delays of the echoes of electromagnetic radiation from the mirror or some other reflecting area related to black hole mimickers. Our results show that photon reflections from such a surface imprint distinct late-time features in the light curve, producing an electromagnetic analogue of gravitational wave echoes. For lower values of the spin, the reflected signal appears within the same orbital period and leads to a noticeable enhancement of the flux. In contrast, for higher spins, the effect emerges only after several orbits, giving rise to a characteristic echo-wave train. These features provide a potential observational signature of horizon-scale modifications in compact objects.

classification.title_zh: 绕Kerr黑洞冒名者轨道运行的热斑电磁辐射中回波的时间
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究了围绕Kerr黑洞候选体做开普勒轨道运动的孤立亮斑的光变曲线，以探测相对于标准事件视界图像的可能偏差。特别是，我们探索了视界附近存在反射面（即“镜子”）的情况及其可观测后果。我们给出了来自镜子或与黑洞模拟器相关的其他反射区域的电磁辐射回波时间延迟的估计。我们的结果表明，来自这种表面的光子反射会在光变曲线中留下明显的晚期特征，产生引力波回波的电磁类比。对于较低的自旋值，反射信号在同一轨道周期内出现，并导致通量的显著增强。相反，对于较高自旋，效应仅在几个轨道之后出现，产生特征性的回波波列。这些特征为致密天体中的视界尺度修改提供了潜在的可观测特征。

papers.title: Sensitivity of black hole spectral instability to ultraviolet perturbations
papers.abstract: Black hole quasinormal modes are known to exhibit spectral instability under ultraviolet perturbations of the effective potential. In the present work, we investigate the sensitivity of the fundamental mode to different types of localized perturbations through a combination of analytic and numerical analyzes. We show that the instability is governed primarily by the effective size of the perturbation rather than by its specific shape. In particular, the instability may persist even in the limit where the width of the perturbation vanishes, provided that the integrated strength of the perturbation is not zero. While a delta-function perturbation destabilizes the fundamental mode through an outward spiral, its interplay with a jump-discontinuity-type perturbation gives rise to competing inward and outward spiral motions. We further show that the stability of the fundamental mode depends sensitively on how the magnitude of the perturbation decreases as it moves away from the compact object, leading to qualitatively distinct outward spirals, inward spirals, and rotational trajectories. Finally, we investigate the motion of the fundamental mode in perturbed Regge-Wheeler potentials containing a jump discontinuity associated with a thin matter shell surrounding the black hole. The resulting behavior qualitatively resembles the spiral structure observed in double-sided P\"oschl-Teller potentials, suggesting that the mechanisms identified in analytically tractable models persist in more realistic black hole effective potentials. The present results indicate that the spectral instability of low-lying black hole modes is considerably richer than previously anticipated and may have important implications for black hole spectroscopy in realistic astrophysical environments.

classification.title_zh: 黑洞谱不稳定性对紫外扰动的敏感性
classification.abstract_zh: 黑洞拟正规模态已知在有效势的紫外扰动下表现出谱不稳定性。在本工作中，我们通过解析和数值分析相结合，研究了基模对不同类型局域扰动的敏感性。我们表明，不稳定性主要由扰动的有效尺寸而非其具体形状决定。特别地，当扰动宽度趋于零但积分强度不为零时，不稳定性可能仍然存在。虽然δ函数扰动通过向外螺旋使基模失稳，但它与跳跃间断型扰动的相互作用会产生竞争性的向内和向外螺旋运动。我们进一步表明，基模的稳定性敏感地依赖于扰动随距离致密天体向外移动而减小的方式，这导致性质不同的向外螺旋、向内螺旋和旋转轨迹。最后，我们研究了在包含与围绕黑洞的薄物质壳相关的跳跃间断的扰动Regge-Wheeler势中基模的运动。所得行为在性质上类似于双侧Pöschl-Teller势中观察到的螺旋结构，表明在解析可处理模型中识别的机制在更真实黑洞有效势中仍然存在。这些结果表明，低位黑洞模的谱不稳定性比先前预期的丰富得多，并且可能对现实天体物理环境中的黑洞光谱学具有重要意义。
classification.one_liner: 展示了黑洞拟正规模谱不稳定性主要受扰动有效尺寸控制，并揭示了δ函数与间断扰动结合时更丰富的螺旋动力学。

papers.title: A no-go study on gravitational helicity in connection variables
papers.abstract: We study the gravitational helicity using the covariant phase space method. Starting from the covariant phase space of general relativity expressed in terms of connection variables, we construct the symplectic form and identify a duality transformation based on the internal Hodge dual. In the complex self-dual Ashtekar variables the duality becomes a simple $U(1)$ phase rotation. We show, however, that this rotation is not a symmetry.We also show that the expression $\int_\Sigma\Sigma^{+AB}\wedge A^+_{AB}$ inspired by the electromagnetic helicity is neither a Noether charge nor a moment map.The duality of general relativity under a rotation of the curvature two-form is a symmetry of the equations of motion but not of the Lagrangian, and carries no Noether charge. An explicit computation shows that the mass and the NUT charge are not symplectically conjugate, so even in the reduced phase space of stationary solutions this duality has no moment map. This study therefore provides counter examples to the existence of a full-theory gravitational helicity in the covariant phase space approach.

classification.title_zh: 联络变量中引力螺旋度的一个不可能性研究
classification.abstract_zh: 我们利用协变相空间方法研究引力螺旋度。从用联络变量表示的一般相对论的协变相空间出发，构造了辛形式，并基于内部霍奇对偶确定了一个对偶变换。在复自对偶Ashtekar变量中，该对偶变为简单的U(1)相位旋转。然而，我们表明该旋转并非对称性。我们还表明，受电磁螺旋度启发的表达式∫ΣΣ^{+AB}∧A^+_{AB}既不是Noether荷也不是矩映射。广义相对论在曲率二形式旋转下的对偶性是运动方程的对称性，但不是拉格朗日量的对称性，因此不携带Noether荷。显式计算表明，质量与NUT荷不是辛共轭的，因此即使在静态解约化相空间中，该对偶也没有矩映射。因此，本研究为协变相空间方法中不存在全理论引力螺旋度提供了反例。
classification.one_liner: 通过协变相空间方法证明，基于内部对偶的引力螺旋度变换在联络变量中不是对称性，且不存在相应的Noether荷或矩映射。

papers.title: Pitching Cosmic Curveballs: Environmental Effects on Extreme-Mass-Ratio Inspirals with Spinning Secondaries
papers.abstract: Much like the aerodynamic deflection of a spinning curveball, a rotating secondary in an extreme-mass-ratio inspiral (EMRI) experiences Magnus and lift forces, in addition to the standard drag force, when traversing a gaseous environment. We present the first framework that incorporates these specific spin-coupled environmental effects (EEs) into the evolution of EMRI. Over the multi-year observation windows of space-based gravitational-wave (GW) detectors, these interactions imprint a unique, distinguishable dephasing signature on the signal. Crucially, a Fisher matrix analysis reveals that gas drag breaks the fundamental vacuum-projection degeneracy between the secondary's spin magnitude and inclination, thereby tightening parameter constraints. Thus, accounting for EEs is not merely a modeling necessity, but could potentially be a powerful tool for enhancing the detectability of the secondary's intrinsic spin, and could serve as a novel probe of accretion flows harboring massive black holes.

classification.title_zh: 投出宇宙曲线球：旋转次级体的极端质量比旋进中的环境效应
classification.abstract_zh: 类似于旋转曲线球的空气动力学偏转，极端质量比旋进（EMRI）中的旋转次级体在穿越气态环境时，除标准阻力外，还会经历马格努斯力和升力。我们提出了第一个将这些特定的自旋耦合环境效应（EEs）纳入EMRI演化的框架。在空间引力波（GW）探测器长达数年的观测窗口内，这些相互作用会在信号上留下独特且可区分的失谐特征。关键在于，Fisher矩阵分析表明，气体阻力打破了次级体自旋大小与倾角之间的基本真空投影简并，从而加强了参数约束。因此，考虑环境效应不仅是建模的必要条件，还可能成为增强次级体内禀自旋可探测性的有力工具，并可作为探测超大质量黑洞周围吸积流的新途径。
classification.one_liner: 首个将旋转次级体受气体环境导致的马格努斯/升力效应纳入EMRI演化的框架，可打破自旋参数简并并增强引力波探测能力。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文研究经典引力中的EMRI与引力波信号，直接属于用户重点标签“经典引力/广义相对论”范畴。

papers.title: Causal Horizons, Geodesic Completeness and Stability in Slow Contraction Cosmology
papers.abstract: We show that cosmological models with a semi-infinite phase of slow contraction (ekpyrosis) possess a combination of properties that can address several fundamental problems in cosmology, otherwise faced in contracting de Sitter phases or standard big bang expansion. In particular, slow contraction admits a stable past attractor asymptoting to Minkowski space, as well as a stable, flat, homogeneous, and isotropic future attractor with negligible Weyl curvature (and, therefore, negligible gravitational entropy). In bouncing cosmologies, this contracting attractor is terminated by a smooth, non-singular bounce that transforms the attractor properties at the end of contraction into the initial conditions for the subsequent expanding phase. Cosmologies incorporating a slow contraction phase have no particle horizon and therefore avoid the causal horizon problem. The past Minkowski attractor also generates an initial spectrum of vacuum-like quantum fluctuations on all wavelengths. Moreover, because the averaged expansion rate along past-directed geodesics is non-positive, models incorporating a semi-infinite phase of slow contraction also evade the Borde,Guth and Vilenkin theorem and are past geodesically complete. By contrast, contracting de Sitter space possesses a finite particle horizon and becomes unstable in the presence of scalar fields, matter, or radiation.

classification.title_zh: 慢收缩宇宙学中的因果视界、测地完备性与稳定性
classification.abstract_zh: 我们证明，具有半无限慢收缩（ekpyrotic）阶段的宇宙学模型具备一系列性质组合，能够解决标准膨胀、收缩 de Sitter 阶段中面临的若干基本宇宙学问题。特别地，慢收缩允许一个稳定过去吸引子渐近于闵可夫斯基时空，以及一个具有可忽略 Weyl 曲率（因此引力熵可忽略）的稳定平坦、均匀、各向同性未来吸引子。在反弹宇宙学中，这一收缩吸引子由一个光滑、非奇异的反弹所终止，将收缩结束时的吸引子性质转化为随后膨胀阶段的初始条件。包含慢收缩阶段的宇宙学没有粒子视界，因此避免了因果视界问题。过去的闵可夫斯基吸引子还在所有波长上产生真空涨落的初始谱。此外，由于沿过去定向测地线的平均膨胀率非正，包含半无限慢收缩阶段的模型也规避了 Borde、Guth 和 Vilenkin 定理，并且在过去方向上是测地完备的。相形之下，收缩的 de Sitter 空间具有有限粒子视界，并且在存在标量场、物质或辐射时变得不稳定。
classification.one_liner: 该文论证慢收缩宇宙学具有稳定的闵可夫斯基过去吸引子、无粒子视界、过去测地完备性等特征，并通过非奇异反弹设定膨胀初始条件；相比而言，收缩 de Sitter 具有有限视界且不稳定。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文研究的是经典宇宙学中的慢收缩模型，与用户侧重的全息超导、p波与多分量序参量、QNM与非线性演化等强关联/全息方向无直接交集，仅与经典引力/广义相对论大背景相关。

papers.title: Corrected thermodynamics and radiation predictions of modified black bounce compact objects
papers.abstract: We study the thermodynamic properties and radiation characteristics of a regular compact object obtained by applying the Simpson-Visser (SV) regularisation to the Schwarzschild modified gravity black hole. The resulting SV-MOG spacetime, whose lapse function involves both the MOG coupling parameter alpha and the black-bounce parameter l, smoothly interpolates between a regular black hole, a one-way wormhole, and a traversable wormhole depending on the parameter l. We derive the Hawking temperature and heat capacity for the black hole branch, identifying second-order phase transitions signaled by sign changes in CV, and, for the horizonless wormhole branch where no causal horizon and hence no genuine Hawking radiation exists we instead construct a physically well-defined effective temperature from the Lyapunov exponent of the unstable photon sphere. Quantum gravitational corrections to the entropy are incorporated via logarithmic terms parameterized by coefficients beta1, beta2, whose theoretically preferred ranges in loop quantum gravity and string theory we discuss, and we show that deviations from the Bekenstein-Hawking area law become significant at small horizon radii. A linear scalar-perturbation analysis further shows that the effective radial potential remains non-negative throughout the black-hole exterior and across the wormhole throat, indicating stability against monopole perturbations independently of the thermodynamic stability inferred from the heat capacity.

secondary_topics: 相变/气泡成核/引力热力学
classification.title_zh: 修正的black bounce致密天体的热力学与辐射预言
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究了将Simpson-Visser(SV)正则化应用于Schwarzschild修改引力黑洞所得到的正则致密天体的热力学和辐射性质。所得SV-MOG时空的lapse函数同时涉及MOG耦合参数alpha和black-bounce参数l，它随参数l平滑插值于正则黑洞、单向虫洞和可穿越虫洞之间。我们推导了黑洞分支的Hawking温度和热容，通过CV的符号变化识别出二级相变；对于没有因果视界因而没有真正Hawking辐射的无视界虫洞分支，我们改为从不稳定光子球的Lyapunov指数构造物理上定义良好的有效温度。通过由参数beta1、beta2参数化的对数项纳入对熵的量子引力修正，我们讨论了在圈量子引力和弦理论中理论上偏好范围，并显示相对于Bekenstein-Hawking面积律的偏差在小视界半径处变得显著。进一步的线性标量扰动分析表明，有效径向势在整个黑洞外部以及虫洞喉部保持非负，说明与从热容推断的热力学稳定性无关，系统对单极扰动是稳定的。
classification.one_liner: 研究修改的black bounce致密天体的热力学、Hawking/有效温度、热容相变和量子引力修正熵，并检验标量扰动稳定性。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文聚焦经典/修改引力下的黑洞与虫洞热力学和辐射，不涉及AdS/CFT等全息方向；仅匹配经典引力/广义相对论支线，故为中等相关。

papers.title: Site selection for the Laser Interferometer Lunar Antenna (LILA)
papers.abstract: The Earth's Moon presents a uniquely advantageous environment for detecting astrophysical gravitational waves (GWs), particularly in the decihertz regime. The Laser Interferometer Lunar Antenna (LILA) project plans to perform GW measurements on the lunar surface, using the Moon's seismic quietness to access this band. Two mission concepts are considered: the proof-of-concept 1 km initial LILA (iLILA) and the full LILA Observatory, whose equilateral arms are at least 40 km long. The Moon's changing orientation and orbital motion provide the time-dependent source modulation needed for sky localization, so the detector response does not impose a unique lunar region. Practical considerations, most critically line of sight (LOS), nevertheless constrain deployment. A coarse-to-fine search of existing lunar datasets identifies and ranks candidate grid locations. Of 4,050 global grid seeds, 434 iLILA seeds and 71 Observatory circumcenters pass both search stages. These results demonstrate that sites suitable for GW detection naturally exist in large numbers on the lunar surface.

classification.title_zh: 月球激光干涉仪天线（LILA）选址研究
classification.abstract_zh: 地球的月球为探测天体物理引力波，特别是分赫兹频段的引力波，提供了独特而有利的环境。激光干涉仪月球天线（LILA）项目计划利用月球的低地震噪声在月球表面进行引力波测量。研究考虑两种任务概念：1公里长度的概念验证型初始LILA（iLILA）和臂长至少40公里的完整LILA天文台。月球的朝向变化与轨道运动提供了源定位所需的时间相关调制，因此探测器响应并不限定唯一月面区域。然而，实际因素（尤其是视线条件）限制了部署位置。通过从粗到细的现有月球数据集搜索，识别并排序了候选网格位置。在4050个全球网格种子中，有434个iLILA种子和71个天文台外心通过了两阶段搜索。结果表明，适合引力波探测的月面地点自然大量存在。
classification.one_liner: 评估月球引力波探测器LILA的候选选址，发现月球表面存在大量适合探测的地点。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于引力波探测实验选址研究，与理论全息或量子引力无关，仅与经典引力/广义相对论中的引力波方向有间接关联。

papers.title: Terrestrial Gravitational Wave Detection with Atom Interferometers
papers.abstract: Atom interferometers (AIFs) are highly precise inertial sensors and are considered promising instruments for the detection of gravitational waves (GWs) and certain dark matter (DM) candidates in the mid-frequency band. While GW detection with AIFs was initially proposed for space-based experiments with baselines spanning thousands of kilometers, recent developments suggest that terrestrial setups with baselines of at least 100 meters may also be capable of detecting GWs. In this work, we analytically derive the GW phase response formula of a ground detector, find an additional term compared to the existing literature and check it our findings numerically. Based on this treatment, we analyze the optimal geometric parameters for earth-bound AIF experiments. Subsequently, we numerically simulate GW detection schemes for these optimized interferometers using an open-source Python algorithm. Numerical simulations of these schemes have are not available to the community, yet crucial for the accurate modeling of noise and non-trivial gravitational backgrounds.

classification.title_zh: 基于原子干涉仪的地面引力波探测
classification.abstract_zh: 原子干涉仪（AIFs）是高精度惯性传感器，被认为是在中频段探测引力波（GW）和某些暗物质（DM）候选者的有前景仪器。虽然最初提出的基于AIF的引力波探测是空间任务，基线跨度达数千公里，但近期发展表明，基线至少100米的地面装置也可能探测到引力波。在这项工作中，我们解析地推导了地面探测器的引力波相位响应公式，发现其中比现有文献多出一项，并通过数值计算验证了我们的结果。基于这一处理方法，我们分析了地球约束AIF实验的最优几何参数。随后，我们使用一个开源Python算法对这些优化后的干涉仪的引力波探测方案进行了数值模拟。这些方案的数值模拟此前尚未公开，而对于精确模拟噪声和非平凡的引力背景至关重要。
classification.one_liner: 解析推导地面原子干涉仪引力波相位响应公式，发现新项，并优化几何参数及数值模拟。
classification.relevance_reason: 该论文聚焦于经典引力波探测技术，与全息对偶或量子引力等理论无关，仅与广义相对论的实验检验间接相关。

papers.title: Holographic duality between bulk topological order and boundary mixed-state order
papers.abstract: We introduce a holographic framework for analyzing the steady states of repeated quantum channels with strong symmetries. Using channel-state duality, we show that the steady state of a $d$-dimensional quantum channel is holographically mapped to the boundary reduced density matrix of a $(d+1)$-dimensional wavefunction generated by a sequential unitary circuit. From this perspective, strong-to-weak spontaneous symmetry breaking (SWSSB) in the steady state arises from the anyon condensation on the boundary of a topological order in one higher dimension. The conditional mutual information (CMI) associated with SWSSB is then inherited from the bulk topological entanglement entropy. We make this duality explicit using isometric tensor network states (isoTNS) by identifying the channel's time evolution with the transfer matrix of a higher-dimensional isoTNS. Built on isoTNS, we further construct continuously tunable quantum channels that exhibit distinct mixed-state phases and transitions in the steady states.

classification.title_zh: 体拓扑序与边界混合态序之间的全息对偶
classification.abstract_zh: 引入一个全息框架来分析具有强对称性的重复量子信道的稳态。利用信道-态对偶，证明 d 维量子信道的稳态被全息映射到一个由顺序幺正电路生成的 (d+1) 维波函数的边界约化密度矩阵。从这一视角，稳态中的强到弱自发对称破缺（SWSSB）源于高一个维度的拓扑序边界上的任意子凝聚，与 SWSSB 关联的条件互信息则继承自体拓扑纠缠熵。通过等距张量网络态（isoTNS）将信道的时间演化与高维 isoTNS 的转移矩阵等同，使该对偶具体化，并进一步构造了连续可调的量子信道，展示稳态中不同的混合态相和相变。
classification.one_liner: 通过量子信道稳态与高维体拓扑序边界态的对应，揭示 SWSSB 源于任意子凝聚，并利用等距张量网络构造了可调混合态相变模型。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文研究量子信道与拓扑序的体-边界全息对偶，属于量子信息/张量网络全息，而非传统 AdS/CFT 引力全息或用户关注的全息超导、经典引力等方向，与重点标签无交集。

papers.title: Medium effect on spin alignment of strange and charm vector mesons
papers.abstract: Understanding the spin alignment of vector mesons in relativistic heavy-ion collisions requires a nonperturbative description of their spin-dependent in-medium properties. We investigate this problem within a unified four-flavor soft-wall holographic framework that combines an anisotropic Einstein--Maxwell--dilaton background at finite temperature, baryon chemical potential, and angular velocity. Spin alignment is determined from the medium-induced splitting of the spin-resolved vector-current spectral functions through an instantaneous freeze-out prescription. We systematically study the strange and charm vector mesons $K^{*}$, $\phi$, $D^{*}$, $D_s^{*}$, and $J/\psi$ and the dependence of their spin alignment on transverse momentum, rapidity, temperature, baryon chemical potential, and angular velocity. We find that the heavy charm vector mesons $D^{*}$, $D_s^{*}$, and $J/\psi$ mesons exhibit $\rho_{00}>1/3$ at low transverse momentum, whereas the light strange vector mesons $K^{*}$ and $\phi$ exhibit the opposite low-momentum behavior and angular distributions with $\rho_{00}<1/3$. We trace this flavor-dependent separation to the different locations of the vacuum mass shell relative to the thermally shifted longitudinal and transverse spectral peaks. The results qualitatively reproduce several trends observed at low and intermediate transverse momentum. Spin alignment is insensitive to baryon chemical potential and only weakly affected by angular velocity. These results establish an equilibrium holographic baseline for vector-meson spin alignment across flavor sectors and help delineate the regimes in which additional mechanisms, such as nonequilibrium evolution, fluctuations, and hard production, become important.

classification.title_zh: 奇异和粲矢量介子自旋排列的介质效应
classification.abstract_zh: 理解相对论性重离子碰撞中矢量介子的自旋排列需要对其自旋依赖的介质内性质进行非微扰描述。我们在一个统一的四味软墙全息框架内研究该问题，该框架结合了有限温度、重子化学势和角速度下的各向异性爱因斯坦-麦克斯韦-膨胀子背景。自旋排列通过瞬时冻结出射方案，由自旋分辨的矢量流谱函数的介质诱导劈裂确定。我们系统地研究了奇异和粲矢量介子 K^*、φ、D^*、D_s^* 和 J/ψ，以及它们的自旋排列对横动量、快度、温度、重子化学势和角速度的依赖。我们发现重粲矢量介子 D^*、D_s^* 和 J/ψ 在低横动量下表现为 ρ_00 > 1/3，而轻奇异矢量介子 K^* 和 φ 则表现出相反的低动量行为和角分布，ρ_00 < 1/3。我们将这种味道依赖的分离归因于真空质量壳相对于热移动的纵、横谱峰位置的不同。结果定性地重现了低和中等横动量下观察到的若干趋势。自旋排列对重子化学势不敏感，仅受角速度弱影响。这些结果为跨味道扇区的矢量介子自旋排列建立了一个平衡全息基线，并有助于圈定额外机制（如非平衡演化、涨落和硬产生）变得重要的区域。
classification.one_liner: 通过四味软墙全息模型研究矢量介子自旋排列的介质效应，发现奇异与粲介子低横动量行为相反，并建立平衡全息基线。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于全息 QCD/核物理中的重离子介子自旋排列研究，与用户重点标签（如全息超流、相变、QNM等）无直接重叠。

papers.title: Primordial black holes and induced gravitational waves from localized features in DBI inflation
papers.abstract: We investigate primordial black hole formation in a Dirac-Born-Infeld inflationary framework in which the background dynamics are determined by explicit functional forms of the inflaton potential $V(\phi)$ and the warp factor $f(\phi)$. The background equations are solved numerically to obtain the evolution of the slow-roll parameters. We show that a localized feature in the potential, accompanied by a correlated structure in the warp factor, dynamically induces a transient suppression of the slow-roll parameter, leading to a short-lived non-attractor phase. This behavior generates an enhancement of the curvature power spectrum on small scales, while preserving consistency with CMB-scale observables. The Mukhanov-Sasaki equation is then solved numerically to compute the resulting power spectrum, which exhibits narrow and localized peaks in the PBH abundance across different mass ranges. We also evaluate the associated stochastic background of induced gravitational waves and find that the predicted signal can fall within the sensitivity bands of future pulsar timing arrays and space-based interferometers, depending on the scale of the inflationary feature. A parameter scan in the $(r,n_s)$ plane shows that the large-scale predictions remain consistent with current observational constraints.

classification.title_zh: DBI暴胀中局域特征产生的原初黑洞与诱导引力波
classification.abstract_zh: 我们在 Dirac-Born-Infeld (DBI) 暴胀框架下研究原初黑洞的形成，其中背景动力学由暴胀子势 V(φ) 和翘曲因子 f(φ) 的显式函数形式决定。数值求解背景方程得到慢滚参数的演化。我们证明，势中的局域特征伴随翘曲因子中的相关结构，会动力学地诱发慢滚参数的瞬态压低，从而导致短命的非吸引子阶段。这种行为在小尺度上增强曲率功率谱，同时保持与 CMB 尺度可观测量的相容性。随后数值求解 Mukhanov-Sasaki 方程计算所得功率谱，结果显示在不同质量范围内 PBH 丰度出现窄而局域的峰。我们还评估了相关的诱导引力波随机背景，发现预测信号可以落入未来脉冲星计时阵列和空间干涉仪的灵敏度带内，具体取决于暴胀特征所处的尺度。在 (r, n_s) 平面上的参数扫描表明，大尺度预言与当前观测约束一致。
classification.one_liner: 在 DBI 暴胀中引入局域的势与翘曲因子结构，可增强小尺度曲率功率谱并产生原初黑洞与可被未来探测器观测的诱导引力波。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于宇宙学暴胀与原初黑洞/引力波方向，与用户重点标签中的全息凝聚态、超流超导等支线不相关；仅因涉及引力波和黑洞现象而与经典引力/广义相对论支线有微弱关联。

papers.title: NS-UNO: Neutron Star EoS Inference from an Unconstrained Number of Observations
papers.abstract: Future multimessenger observations of neutron stars (NS) are expected to substantially increase both the number and precision of astrophysical constraints on the equation of state (EoS) of dense matter. This motivates inference frameworks capable of accommodating a variable, non fixed number of observations while preserving the posterior information associated with each measurement. In this work, we introduce NS-UNO, a Neural Posterior Estimation framework for NS EoS inference designed to accommodate an Unconstrained Number of Observations (UNO). NS-UNO combines a hierarchical DeepSets model with a conditional normalising flow, enabling a single trained model to perform inference from mass-radius observation sets of varying size, with each observation represented by a set of posterior samples. We demonstrate accurate and well calibrated posterior reconstructions using a model trained jointly on piecewise polytropic and non-parametric Gaussian process EoS ensembles. The reconstruction improves as observations probe a broader range of NS masses, while remaining robust to variations in the number and precision of the observations. The model also generalises to EoSs outside the families used during training. Finally, we qualitatively demonstrate the framework on current multimessenger constraints from NICER and GW170817. NS-UNO provides a flexible and scalable approach to NS EoS inference, naturally suited to the increasingly diverse observational datasets expected from next generation multimessenger astronomy.

classification.title_zh: NS-UNO: 基于不受观测数量限制的中子星状态方程推断
classification.abstract_zh: 未来中子星（NS）的多信使观测预计将大幅增加对致密物质状态方程（EoS）的天体物理约束的数量和精度。这促使推断框架能够容纳可变、非固定数量的观测，同时保留每次测量相关的后验信息。在这项工作中，我们介绍了NS-UNO，一种用于NS EoS推断的神经后验估计框架，旨在适应不受观测数量限制（UNO）的情况。NS-UNO将层次化DeepSets模型与条件归一化流相结合，使得一个训练好的模型能够对不同大小的质量-半径观测集进行推断，每个观测由一组后验样本表示。我们展示了使用联合训练的分段多方和参数化高斯过程EoS集成所获得的高精度且校准良好的后验重建。随着观测覆盖更广的中子星质量范围，重建效果得到改善，同时对观测数量和精度的变化保持鲁棒。该模型还能推广到训练中未使用的EoS族。最后，我们定性演示了该框架在来自NICER和GW170817的当前多信使约束上的应用。NS-UNO提供了一种灵活且可扩展的NS EoS推断方法，自然适用于下一代多信使天文学预期日益多样化的观测数据集。
classification.one_liner: 提出NS-UNO，一种基于神经后验估计的中子星状态方程推断框架，可处理任意数量的观测样本，并在多信使数据上验证。

papers.title: Examining the possibility of a thick crust in the compact stellar object HESS J1731-347
papers.abstract: A relativistic mean-field model with a crossing term of isovector-scalar and isoscalar mesons, the Cracow crossing terms (CCT) model, has previously been shown to be capable of explaining the light and compact object HESS J1731-347 [11]. Here, the model is supplemented with a correct treatment of the phase transition. Applying the thermodynamically consistent Gibbs conditions shows that a mixed-phase system occurs in the core of the neutron star over a wide range of densities, extending up to the neutron star crust, leading to an intriguing stellar structure with a thick and massive crust.

papers.title: Inspiralling Binary merger parameter reconstruction with lunar and satellite Laser Ranging
papers.abstract: Precision tracking of Earth--Moon and Earth--satellite ranges offers a novel, low-frequency avenue for detecting gravitational waves from inspiralling massive black hole binaries, complementary to space-based interferometers. In this paper, we propose a first study of the reconstruction of the binary parameters from a synthetic set of range observations. \textit{Set-up}: Assuming an ideal unperturbed Keplerian motion for the earth-satellite binary, we develop a framework for reconstructing the chirp mass $\mathcal M_c$ and luminosity distance $D_L$ of chirping sources from the perturbations they induce on ranging observables, using both Lunar Laser Ranging (LLR) and a two-satellite ranging configuration (GUEST) as concrete case studies. \textit{Result}: We find that chirp-mass recovery tightly converges as a power law in SNR ($\sigma_{M_c}/M_c \propto \mathrm{SNR}^{\alpha}$, $\alpha \simeq -1$ to $-1.8$) for both LLR and GUEST. In contrast, the luminosity distance suffers from a severe, SNR-independent degeneracy with the sky-orientation angles in the LLR configuration, yielding fractional biases and uncertainties of tens to over a hundred percent regardless of signal strength. The two-satellite GUEST configuration breaks this degeneracy and restores a convergent, SNR-dependent recovery of $D_L$ comparable in scaling to that of the chirp mass. These results demonstrate that multi-baseline ranging architectures are essential for extracting luminosity-distance information from ranging-based gravitational wave searches, while chirp-mass measurements remain reliably accessible even with a single ranging baseline such as the Earth--Moon system.

classification.title_zh: 月球与卫星激光测距对旋进双星合并参数的重构
classification.abstract_zh: 对地月距离和地球-卫星距离的精密跟踪为探测旋进大质量黑洞双星产生的引力波提供了一种新颖的低频途径，是对空间干涉仪的补充。本文首次研究了从合成距离观测中重构双星参数的问题。设置：假设地球-卫星双星为理想的无扰动开普勒运动，我们建立了一个框架，从这些测距观测量所受的扰动中重构啁啾质量 M_c 和光度距离 D_L，并以月球激光测距（LLR）和双卫星测距配置（GUEST）作为具体案例研究。结果：我们发现，对于 LLR 和 GUEST，啁啾质量的重构都按 SNR 的幂律紧密收敛（σ_{M_c}/M_c ∝ SNR^α，α ≈ -1 到 -1.8）。相比之下，在 LLR 配置中，光度距离与天空方向角存在严重的、与 SNR 无关的简并，导致分数偏差和不确定度达百分之几十到超过百分之百，与信号强度无关。双卫星 GUEST 配置打破了这一简并，并恢复了 D_L 的收敛的、依赖于 SNR 的重构，其缩放行为与啁啾质量相当。这些结果表明，多基线测距架构对于从基于测距的引力波搜索中提取光度距离信息至关重要，而即使单条测距基线（如地月系统）也能可靠地测量啁啾质量。
classification.one_liner: 研究了利用月球和卫星激光测距重构双星啁啾质量与光度距离的可行性，发现双卫星配置可解决光度距离简并问题。

papers.title: Stationary Rotating Geometries Associated with Nonsingular Pulsating Collapse
papers.abstract: Since the first exact solutions of General Relativity (GR) were obtained, it became clear that the theory predicts a new class of compact objects: black holes. The Hawking--Penrose singularity theorems show that, under appropriate assumptions, gravitational collapse in GR leads to singular behavior. Motivated by the expectation that such regimes require physics beyond classical GR, effective approaches inspired by Loop Quantum Cosmology (LQC) and braneworld scenarios introduce high-density corrections. In this work we consider the static exterior geometry introduced by Gao, Lu, Shen, and Faraoni, associated with a comoving interior model in which the singularity is avoided through a sequence of collapse and bounce phases. Using the Newman--Janis algorithm in the Azreg-A\"inou formulation, we construct a stationary rotating exterior extension of this geometry. The resulting line element describes a stationary axisymmetric rotating spacetime whose horizon geometry, angular velocity, surface gravity, and Hawking temperature recover the Kerr and Schwarzschild limits when the quantum/braneworld correction becomes negligible ($l\to 0$). We further analyze the thermal response at fixed rotational state-space parameter, identify Davies-type singular points, and formulate an extended thermodynamic state-space relation.

classification.title_zh: 与非奇异脉动坍缩相关的稳态旋转几何
classification.abstract_zh: 自广义相对论（GR）得到首批精确解以来，该理论就预言了一类新的致密天体：黑洞。Hawking--Penrose奇点定理表明，在适当假设下，GR中的引力坍缩会导致奇异行为。受这类情形可能需要超越经典GR物理的预期启发，受环量子宇宙学（LQC）和膜世界情景启发的有效方法引入了高密度修正。本文考虑 Gao, Lu, Shen, 和 Faraoni 引入的静态外部几何，它对应于一个通过一系列坍缩和反弹阶段避免奇点的共动内部模型。利用 Azreg-Aïnou 形式中的 Newman--Janis 算法，我们构造了这一几何的稳态旋转外部延拓。所得线元描述一个稳态轴对称旋转时空，其视界几何、角速度、表面引力和 Hawking 温度在量子/膜世界修正可忽略（l→0）时恢复 Kerr 和 Schwarzschild 极限。我们进一步分析了固定旋转状态空间参数下的热响应，识别出 Davies 型奇异点，并建立了一个扩展的热力学状态空间关系。
classification.one_liner: 构造带量子/膜世界修正的非奇异脉动坍缩外部的稳态旋转几何，并在修正消失时回到Kerr/Schwarzschild极限，同时分析其热力学性质。

papers.title: Schwarzschild spectral ladders on the negative imaginary axis: Endpoint nonselection, branch-cut phase, and Jost classification
papers.abstract: Compactified spectral discretisations may yield stable negative-imaginary-axis (NIA) eigenvalue ladders, but finite-matrix convergence does not establish quasinormal poles. For axial Schwarzschild perturbations, ingoing--outgoing factorisation leaves an unwanted horizon solution behaving as $t^{4\alpha}$ at $\Omega=-i\alpha$, and a $C^\infty$-flat unwanted infinity solution. Thus endpoint $C^k$ regularity is nonselective for $4\alpha>k$, so the $C^2$ continuum problem cannot have a discrete NIA spectrum over $\alpha\simeq15$--32. Exact Chebyshev-grid formulas give roots-grid maximum radius $O(n^{2p})$ for $x\sim C(1-y)^{-p}$, explaining C1, $x=2/(1-y)$, versus C2, $x=4/(1-y)^2$. Arbitrary-precision pencils nevertheless reveal a reproducible 68-point C1 ladder, while C2 reorganises it. Both physical lateral Jost determinants remain stably nonzero at every C1 frequency. A 0.05-spaced on-cut scan finds no zero, and refined argument-principle calculations give zero winding in both continuation strips. This rejects all 68 candidates, although the mesh and strip evidence is not interval-certified. Same-damping controls recover Schwarzschild QNMs $n=60,100,130$, with $|\widehat{\mathcal D}|=10^{-48}$--$10^{-56}$. The ladder has surface-gravity quarter spacing, follows the parameter-free Casals--Ottewill branch-cut-strength phase, and pairs with damping projections of QNMs $n=62,\ldots,129$. At its first member, a finite-frequency calculation finds a branch-strength zero at $\alpha_q=15.07832396512359$, between the asymptotic prediction and the C1 root, supporting, but not proving, sequence-wide cut-phase locking. Thus accurate finite-pencil eigenvalues can fail the invariant Jost/Evans pole criterion. Whether representation-dependent nodes with Keldysh weights converge collectively to the Schwarzschild cut response and Price tail remains open.

classification.title_zh: 负虚轴上的 Schwarzschild 谱阶梯：端点非选择性、割线相位与 Jost 分类
classification.abstract_zh: 紧致化谱离散化可能产生稳定的负虚轴（NIA）本征值阶梯，但有限矩阵收敛并不能确定准正则极点。对于轴向 Schwarzschild 扰动，出入波分解会留下一个在 Ω=-iα 处行为如 t^{4α} 的不需要的视界解，以及一个 C^∞ 平坦的不需要的无穷远解。因此端点 C^k 正则性在 4α>k 时不具选择性，故在 α≃15--32 区间上，C^2 连续统问题不可能有离散的 NIA 谱。精确 Chebyshev 网格公式给出的根-网格最大半径为 O(n^{2p})，其中 x∼C(1-y)^{-p}，这解释了 C1（x=2/(1-y)）与 C2（x=4/(1-y)^2）的差异。尽管如此，任意精度铅笔计算仍揭示了一个可复现的 68 点 C1 阶梯，而 C2 会对其重组。在每个 C1 频率处，两个物理横向 Jost 行列式都保持稳定非零。0.05 间隔的割线扫描未发现零点，精化幅角原理计算在两个连续条带中均给出零环绕数。这拒绝了全部 68 个候选，尽管网格与条带证据并非区间证明。相同阻尼对照恢复了 Schwarzschild QNM n=60,100,130，其 |\widehat{\mathcal D}|=10^{-48}--10^{-56}。该阶梯具有表面引力四分之一间距，遵循无参数 Casals--Ottewill 割线强度相位，并与 QNM n=62,...,129 的阻尼投影配对。在其第一个成员处，有限频率计算发现分支强度零点位于 α_q=15.07832396512359，介于渐近预测与 C1 根之间，支持但不证明序列范围的割线相位锁定。因此，精确的有限铅笔本征值可能无法通过不变的 Jost/Evans 极点判据。表示依赖的带 Keldysh 权重的节点是否会集体收敛到 Schwarzschild 割线响应和 Price 尾巴，仍有待探索。
classification.one_liner: 通过 Jost/Evans 极点判据与任意精度计算，说明 Schwarzschild 轴向扰动在负虚轴上由紧致化谱离散化得到的 68 个候选本征值均非真实准正则极点，并指出这类表示依赖的阶梯与割线响应及 Price 尾巴的关系仍开放。

papers.title: Exact dynamics and the spin wall for large-spin particles in Schwarzschild spacetime
papers.abstract: The motion of a spinning test particle in a curved spacetime is governed by the Mathisson--Papapetrou--Dixon (MPD) equations and deviates from geodesic motion already at first order in the spin. While essentially all existing studies truncate the dynamics at linear order in the spin, we present an exact, nonperturbative treatment of planar motion in Schwarzschild spacetime under the Tulczyjew--Dixon spin supplementary condition: eliminating the four-velocity recasts the MPD system into a closed algebraic form and reduces the radial motion to an effective-potential problem, with no expansion in the spin at any stage. This exact framework uncovers qualitative features that are absent from---and in fact unattainable within---the linearized description. Most notably, for sufficiently large spin the effective potential develops a double root at a characteristic radius determined solely by the particle mass and spin, marking an impenetrable \emph{spin wall} of purely spin origin; beyond a critical spin the wall lies outside the event horizon and shields it from generic infalling particles. Moreover, the wall is a filter for particle: only orbits with a specific combinations of spin, angular momentum and energy can penetrate it, all others being reflected before reaching the horizon. In addition, the innermost stable circular orbit, which in linear treatments merely shifts continuously with spin, is obtained in closed form in the weak-field limit and is shown to cease to exist at sufficiently large spin. We further compute the spin correction to the perihelion precession in the weak-field limit and verify that all results reduce to the standard ones at vanishing spin. The spin wall and its filtering rule are genuine nonperturbative phenomena, invisible to any finite-order expansion in the spin, with potential observational signatures in accretion flows around compact objects.

classification.title_zh: Schwarzschild时空中大自旋粒子的精确动力学与自旋墙
classification.abstract_zh: 弯曲时空中旋转测试粒子的运动由Mathisson--Papapetrou--Dixon (MPD)方程控制，并在自旋的一阶就偏离测地线。现有研究基本将动力学截断到自旋的线性阶，而我们在Tulczyjew--Dixon自旋补充条件下，对Schwarzschild时空中的平面运动进行了精确、非微扰处理：消去四速度将MPD系统重写为闭合代数形式，并将径向运动化为有效势问题，整个过程不进行任何自旋展开。这一精确框架揭示了线性化描述中缺失且无法触及的定性特征。最显著的是，对于足够大的自旋，有效势在由粒子质量和自旋决定的特征半径处出现双根，标志着一个纯自旋起源的不可穿透的“自旋墙”；超过临界自旋后，该墙位于事件视界之外，并屏蔽一般下落粒子。此外，自旋墙对粒子具有过滤作用：只有自旋、角动量和能量满足特定组合的轨道才能穿透，其他轨道在到达视界之前被反射。同时，线性处理中随自旋连续移动的最内稳定圆轨道，在弱场极限下得到闭式解，并证明在足够大的自旋下不再存在。我们还计算了弱场极限下近日点进动的自旋修正，并验证所有结果在零自旋时退化到标准形式。自旋墙及其过滤规则是真正的非微扰现象，对自旋的任何有限阶展开均不可见，可能在致密天体周围吸积流中产生可观测特征。
classification.one_liner: 对Schwarzschild时空中旋转测试粒子运动进行精确非微扰求解，发现纯自旋起源的不可穿透“自旋墙”及其过滤机制，并得到最内稳定圆轨道和近日点进动的闭式结果。
